phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE head-to-toe: head/neck - helmet removed, no injury, no midline tenderness elicited but mechanism keeps precautions in place; chest - tender left lateral ribs, equal air entry at all 6 sites, no flail; abdomen - soft, mildly tender suprapubically; back - checked during the scoop transfer, lumbar tenderness, no step deformity; lower extremities - binder in place, left leg shortened and externally rotated, pedal pulses weak but present bilaterally, sensation reduced below both knees; upper extremities - road rash both forearms, CSM intact.
phases.infoZh: 途中从头到脚：头颈——头盔已摘、无损伤、未引出中线压痛但按机制维持防护；胸部——左侧肋部压痛，6 点听诊进气对称，无连枷胸；腹部——软，耻骨上区轻度压痛；背部——铲式转移时已查，腰段压痛，无台阶样畸形；下肢——固定带在位，左腿缩短外旋，双足动脉搏动微弱但可及，双膝以下感觉减退；上肢——双前臂擦伤，远端 CSM 完好。

expected.actionEn: Head/neck exam after controlled helmet removal
expected.actionZh: 在受控摘盔后完成头颈查体

expected.actionEn: Chest exam with 6-site auscultation
expected.actionZh: 胸部查体并 6 点听诊

expected.actionEn: Abdomen exam
expected.actionZh: 腹部查体

expected.actionEn: Back exam during the scoop transfer without rolling the bound pelvis
expected.actionZh: 在铲式转移中完成背部检查，不翻滚已固定的骨盆

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities with distal pulses, sensation and motor function documented bilaterally
expected.actionZh: 下肢并记录双侧远端脉搏、感觉与运动功能

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities with CSM
expected.actionZh: 上肢及远端 CSM

phases.infoEn: Pelvic binding: commercial binder preferred, or three overlapping broad triangular bandages; ZAP STRAPS ARE NOT ACCEPTABLE. Align the centre of the belt with the GREATER TROCHANTERS - not the iliac crests. Tie tightly enough to support but not to cause pain. DO NOT ROLL the patient to apply it. Indications met here: major mechanism plus hemodynamic instability (HR over 100, SBP under 90), pelvic pain and pelvic instability. Transfer with a scoop stretcher or orthopaedic device rather than a log roll. Hypovolemia protocol: supine, warmth, high-flow oxygen, rapid transport. PCP EN ROUTE: vascular access, 20 mL/kg bolus to a maximum of 2 L reassessing every 500 mL with a target systolic of 90; TXA 2 g IV over 1 minute - indicated for shock with a mechanism suggesting ongoing bleeding, within 3 hours, patient over 12 years, not an isolated TBI. Analgesia: Entonox is cautioned in shock - withhold and document.
phases.infoZh: 骨盆固定：首选商品化固定带，或三条宽三角巾重叠；禁止使用扎带。固定带中心对准大转子——不是髂嵴。绑扎要足以支撑但不致引起疼痛。上带时不得翻滚患者。本例符合指征：重大机制加血流动力学不稳定（心率高于 100、收缩压低于 90）、骨盆疼痛、骨盆不稳定。转移用铲式担架或矫形装置，而非轴向翻滚。低血容量协议：仰卧、保暖、高流量吸氧、快速转运。PCP 途中：建立静脉通路，20 mL/kg 补液上限 2 升、每 500 mL 复评、目标收缩压 90；TXA 2 g 静推 1 分钟——休克且机制提示持续出血、伤后 3 小时内、大于 12 岁、非孤立性颅脑伤，有指征。镇痛：休克为 Entonox 慎用情形——暂不给并记录。

expected.actionEn: Apply the pelvic binder correctly: commercial binder or three broad bandages, centred on the greater trochanters, applied without rolling
expected.actionZh: 正确应用骨盆固定带：商品化固定带或三条宽绷带，中心对准大转子，不翻滚患者

expected.actionEn: Execute the Hypovolemia protocol (supine, warmth, high-flow O2, minimal movement, rapid transport)
expected.actionZh: 执行低血容量协议（仰卧、保暖、高流量吸氧、尽量少动、快速转运）

expected.actionEn: Transfer using a scoop or orthopaedic stretcher rather than a log roll
expected.actionZh: 使用铲式或矫形担架转移，而非轴向翻滚

expected.actionEn: PCP: IV access, 20 mL/kg bolus reassessed every 500 mL to a target SBP of 90
expected.actionZh: PCP：静脉通路，20 mL/kg 补液每 500 mL 复评，目标收缩压 90

expected.actionEn: PCP: TXA 2 g IV over 1 minute with contraindications ruled out
expected.actionZh: PCP：TXA 2 g 静推 1 分钟并排除禁忌

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs, the binder position and distal pulses after every move and every 500 mL of fluid. Set 2 (en route after binding and 500 mL): GCS 15; BP 94/60; pulse 118 weak; respirations 24; skin pale cool clammy; pupils equal; SpO2 96% on 15 L; distal pulses still present bilaterally, sensation unchanged. Slight improvement after binding and fluid - continue and reassess.
phases.infoZh: 每次移动及每输注 500 mL 后复评 ABC、固定带位置与远端脉搏。第 2 组（途中，固定并输入 500 mL 后）：GCS 15；血压 94/60；脉搏 118 细弱；呼吸 24；皮肤苍白湿冷；瞳孔等大；SpO2 15 L 下 96%；双侧远端脉搏仍可及，感觉无变化。骨盆固定与补液后略有改善——继续治疗并复评。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs, binder and distal CSM after each move and each 500 mL
expected.actionZh: 每次移动及每 500 mL 后复评 ABC、固定带与远端 CSM

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 5-6 minutes; interpret the response to binding and fluid
expected.actionZh: 5-6 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征；解读对骨盆固定与补液的反应

expected.actionEn: Do not remove or loosen the binder once applied
expected.actionZh: 固定带一旦上好不得取下或放松

phases.infoEn: Critical patient - trauma-centre notification en route. Hand-off must state the binder is in place, the time it was applied, and the fluid and TXA given. PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 危重患者——途中向创伤中心预报。交接必须说明骨盆固定带在位、上带时间以及补液与 TXA 用药。5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: En-route trauma-centre notification
expected.actionZh: 途中创伤中心预报

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off including binder time and neurovascular status of both legs
expected.actionZh: 完整交接（含上带时间与双下肢神经血管状态）

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确 PCR

vitalsSets.timeHint: en route after binder and 500 mL fluid

criticalPitfallsEn: Not applying a pelvic binder when indicated - explicitly listed as a major fracture-management failure detrimental to patient care
Repeatedly springing, rocking or re-palpating the unstable pelvis - disrupts clot and worsens hemorrhage, overall patient care up to 100%
Placing the binder over the iliac crests instead of the greater trochanters, or using zap straps - skill failure 25%
Log-rolling the patient to apply the binder or to check the back - the guideline says do not roll; use a scoop
Removing the helmet without in-line stabilization or as a single rescuer - spinal management failure up to 100%
criticalPitfallsZh: 有指征却不上骨盆固定带——评分手册明列为损害患者的重大骨折处理失误
反复挤压、摇动或再次触诊不稳定骨盆——破坏血凝块加重出血，患者照护类最高扣 100%
固定带压在髂嵴而非大转子，或使用扎带——技能失分 25%
为上固定带或查背部而轴向翻滚患者——指南规定不得翻滚，应使用铲式担架
摘头盔时未维持中线固定或单人操作——脊柱管理失分最高 100%
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR: pelvic binding, two-rescuer helmet removal, spinal packaging with a scoop, high-flow oxygen, shock positioning and warmth, and a 15-minute clock are all EMR-level. No IV, no TXA. Entonox withheld because of shock.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR：骨盆固定、两人摘盔、用铲式担架完成脊柱打包、高流量吸氧、休克体位与保暖、15 分钟时限，全部属 EMR 级。无静脉、无 TXA。因休克不给 Entonox。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds en-route vascular access, a 20 mL/kg bolus (max 2 L, reassess every 500 mL, target SBP 90) and TXA 2 g IV over 1 minute, plus the 9-system Functional Enquiry. Blood at the urethral meatus should be reported to the receiving team.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 增加途中静脉通路、20 mL/kg 补液（上限 2 升、每 500 mL 复评、目标收缩压 90）和 TXA 2 g 静推 1 分钟，以及 9 系统功能问诊。尿道口出血须向接收团队报告。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 41-year-old male motorcyclist who lost control at approximately 90 kilometres an hour at 1522, struck a guardrail and was thrown clear, landing on his left side. He was helmeted and in full leathers with no loss of consciousness. Chief complaint is severe pelvic pain; we found an unstable pelvis with the left leg shortened and externally rotated, and blood at the urethral meatus. Initial vitals GCS 15, BP 86/54, pulse 126 weak, resps 26 shallow, skin pale cool clammy, SpO2 92% on room air; latest BP 94/60, pulse 118 after binding and 500 millilitres of saline. No medical history, no medications, no known allergies, ate at 1300. Treatments: two-rescuer helmet removal with in-line stabilization, pelvic binder applied over the greater trochanters at 1536 and not disturbed since, scoop transfer with full spinal precautions, high-flow oxygen, kept supine and warm, IV with saline bolus running, and TXA 2 grams IV. Pedal pulses have remained present but weak bilaterally with reduced sensation below both knees.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 41 岁男性摩托车骑手，15:22 以约 90 km/h 失控撞上护栏并被抛出，左侧先着地。戴头盔、穿全套皮衣，无意识丧失。主诉为骨盆剧痛；查体发现骨盆不稳定，左腿缩短外旋，尿道口有血迹。首组生命体征 GCS 15、血压 86/54、脉搏 126 细弱、呼吸 26 浅、皮肤苍白湿冷、SpO2 室内空气 92%；骨盆固定并输入 500 mL 生理盐水后末组血压 94/60、脉搏 118。无既往史、无用药、无已知过敏，13:00 进食。处置：两人摘盔并维持中线固定，15:36 于大转子水平上骨盆固定带且此后未再变动，以铲式担架在全脊柱防护下转移，高流量吸氧，保持仰卧保暖，静脉补液中，并给予 TXA 2 g 静推。双足动脉搏动始终微弱但可及，双膝以下感觉减退。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Severe pelvic pain with unstable pelvis after high-speed motorcycle crash
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Lost control at ~90 km/h at 1522, struck guardrail, thrown clear, landed left side then rolled; helmeted, full leathers, no LOC; pelvic pain 9/10, back pain 6/10, numbness below both knees

Blood at urethral meatus

Pedal pulses weak but present bilaterally; sensation reduced below knees
Left lateral rib tenderness, lumbar tenderness, bilateral forearm road rash

scenarios.titleEn: Isolated Mid-Shaft Femur Fracture - Traction Splint and Three-Drug Analgesia
scenarios.titleZh: 孤立性股骨干骨折——牵引夹板与三联镇痛
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1420 hrs. Code 3 to a soccer pitch in Kamloops. 19-year-old male, tackled hard during a game, obvious deformity of the right thigh. Coaches have kept him still. Hospital is 18 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 14:20，Code 3 前往甘露市一处足球场。19 岁男性在比赛中被重铲，右大腿明显畸形。教练已让他保持不动。医院车程 18 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: he is conscious and screaming in pain; no other players injured; there is a first-aid attendant on the field.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：患者清醒、疼得大喊；无其他球员受伤；场边有一名急救员。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge; plan traction splint, analgesia kit (acetaminophen, ibuprofen, Entonox), oxygen and cot
expected.actionZh: 确认；准备牵引夹板、镇痛用具（对乙酰氨基酚、布洛芬、Entonox）、氧气和担架床

expected.actionEn: Anticipate a painful isolated long-bone injury where analgesia comes BEFORE splinting
expected.actionZh: 预判为疼痛剧烈的孤立性长骨损伤，镇痛应在夹板固定之前

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Grass field, dry, sunny, 24 degrees C. Play has stopped and both teams are back on the benches. The patient lies supine mid-field, holding his right thigh, which shows obvious mid-shaft angulation and swelling. The field first-aid attendant reports he did not hit his head and did not lose consciousness. The cot has to come about 60 metres across grass. One patient.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：草地球场，地面干燥，晴天，24 摄氏度。比赛已中止，两队球员都回到替补席。患者仰卧在球场中央，双手护住右大腿，可见股骨中段明显成角和肿胀。场边急救员报告他没有撞到头、也没有昏迷。担架床需要穿过约 60 米草地才能推到。单一患者。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (none significant), environment (open field, 60 m carry), MOI (direct blow to the thigh, no head strike), one patient
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（无明显危险）、环境（开阔球场、需搬运 60 米）、受伤机制（大腿直接撞击、头部未受伤）、单一患者

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜

expected.actionEn: First look: young male supine, in severe pain, obvious mid-thigh deformity, no bleeding through the shorts
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：年轻男性仰卧、剧痛、大腿中段明显畸形、短裤未见渗血

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: alert and oriented, shouting with pain but able to answer. EXAMINER (give when assessed): airway clear; respirations 24, regular; radial pulse 112, strong and regular. Skin: pink, warm, dry (no shock). RBS: isolated CLOSED mid-shaft right femur fracture with obvious angulation and a swollen, tense thigh; DORSALIS PEDIS AND POSTERIOR TIBIAL PULSES PRESENT, sensation intact, he can wiggle his toes; no other injuries anywhere; no head, neck or back pain. SpO2 98% RA. C-spine NOT indicated: no head strike, no LOC, no neck pain, no distracting head/neck injury, alert and non-intoxicated - NEXUS negative. STABLE.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：清醒、定向力正常，痛得喊叫但能回答问题。考官（评估时给出）：气道通畅；呼吸 24 次/分、规则；桡动脉 112 次/分、有力规则。皮肤：红润、温暖、干燥（无休克）。RBS：孤立性右股骨干闭合骨折，明显成角，大腿肿胀紧张；足背动脉与胫后动脉搏动可及，感觉正常，脚趾能活动；全身无其他损伤；无头颈背疼痛。SpO2 室内空气 98%。无颈椎固定指征：头部未撞击、无昏迷、无颈痛、无分散注意力的头颈部损伤、清醒且未醉酒——NEXUS 阴性。患者稳定。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: Alert
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：Alert

expected.actionEn: Question sufficiently to rule OUT c-spine using NEXUS criteria and verbalize the reasoning
expected.actionZh: 用 NEXUS 标准充分问诊以排除颈椎固定指征，并口述推理过程

expected.actionEn: Assess airway
expected.actionZh: 评估气道

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation; note tachycardia is from pain, with no other shock signs
expected.actionZh: 评估循环；注意心动过速源于疼痛，无其他休克体征

expected.actionEn: Rapid body survey; expose the thigh, manually stabilize the limb and check distal circulation, sensation and function
expected.actionZh: 快速查体；暴露大腿、徒手固定患肢并检查远端循环、感觉与活动

expected.actionEn: Note skin: pink warm dry - important evidence against shock in a femur fracture
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：红润温干——是股骨骨折患者未休克的重要证据

expected.actionEn: Verbalize the oxygen decision: SpO2 98% with no distress, so titrate and no supplemental oxygen is required
expected.actionZh: 口述给氧决策：SpO2 98% 且无窘迫，按滴定原则无需吸氧

expected.actionEn: Keep supine with the injured leg in line with the body, supported manually
expected.actionZh: 保持仰卧、患肢与躯干成一直线并徒手支撑

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Isolated closed femur fracture, no shock, distal pulses present, alert = STABLE, NON-RTC. This matters clinically: the traction splint is indicated for suspected mid-shaft femur fractures IN STABLE PATIENTS. Assess, treat, splint, package and be ready to load within 30 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。孤立性闭合股骨骨折、无休克、远端脉搏可及、意识清醒=稳定，非 RTC。这一判断有临床意义：牵引夹板的指征是稳定患者的疑似股骨干骨折。30 分钟内完成评估、处置、夹板、打包并可装载。

expected.actionEn: Categorize correctly as non-RTC and justify it (no shock, distal pulses present, isolated injury)
expected.actionZh: 正确判定为非 RTC 并说明依据（无休克、远端脉搏可及、孤立损伤）

expected.actionEn: Ready to load within 30 minutes while still working with purpose
expected.actionZh: 在保持工作节奏的前提下 30 分钟内可装载

expected.actionEn: Delegate the field attendant and coaches: bring the cot to the patient, clear the carry route, hold manual traction as directed
expected.actionZh: 指挥场边急救员与教练：把担架床推到患者旁、清出搬运路线、按指示维持徒手牵引

phases.infoEn: ACTOR ANSWERS: opponent's knee drove into the outside of his right thigh at speed about 6 minutes ago; he heard a crack and dropped; has not moved the leg since. O - sudden at impact. P - nothing helps, any movement is agony. Q - deep, sharp, grinding. R - does not radiate; no back or hip pain. R (relief) - none. R (recurrence) - first time. S - 10/10. T - constant since impact. No head strike, no LOC, no neck or back pain. PMHx: none; no bleeding disorders. Meds: none - specifically no anticoagulants and nothing taken for pain today. Allergies: none known; specifically no NSAID or acetaminophen allergy. LOI: pasta and a sports drink at 1230, about 2 hours ago.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员回答：约 6 分钟前对方球员的膝盖高速撞在他右大腿外侧；他听到「咔」的一声就倒了；此后没有动过这条腿。O——撞击时突然发生。P——没有任何缓解方式，一动就剧痛。Q——深部、锐利、研磨样。R——不放射；无背部或髋部疼痛。R（缓解）——无。R（复发）——第一次。S——10/10。T——自撞击后持续存在。头部未撞击、无昏迷、无颈背疼痛。既往史：无；无出血性疾病。用药：无——明确未服抗凝药，今天也没吃过任何止痛药。过敏：无已知；明确无非甾体抗炎药或对乙酰氨基酚过敏。最后进食：12:30 意面和运动饮料，约 2 小时前。

expected.actionEn: Establish chief complaint: severe right thigh pain and deformity
expected.actionZh: 确立主诉：右大腿剧痛伴畸形

expected.actionEn: Full OPQRRRST for the pain plus mechanism detail and a specific head/neck/back screen
expected.actionZh: 完整 OPQRRRST 疼痛评估，加受伤机制细节及头/颈/背专项筛查

expected.actionEn: Obtain a 0-10 pain score before analgesia
expected.actionZh: 镇痛前采集 0-10 疼痛评分

expected.actionEn: PMHx incl liver disease, GI bleeding and bleeding disorders (analgesia contraindications)
expected.actionZh: 既往史（含肝病、消化道出血、出血性疾病——镇痛药禁忌）

expected.actionEn: Medications - specifically anticoagulants and any acetaminophen or ibuprofen taken in the last 4-6 hours
expected.actionZh: 用药史——特别是抗凝药，以及过去 4-6 小时内是否服过对乙酰氨基酚或布洛芬

expected.actionEn: Allergies - specifically NSAID and acetaminophen sensitivity
expected.actionZh: 过敏史——特别是非甾体抗炎药与对乙酰氨基酚过敏

expected.actionEn: LOI with time and content
expected.actionZh: 最后进食的时间与内容

phases.infoEn: Set 1 - baseline BEFORE any analgesia (mandatory before initiating the protocol): GCS 15 (E4V5M6); BP 132/78; pulse 112 strong regular; respirations 24 regular; skin pink warm dry; pupils equal reactive, 4 mm; SpO2 98% RA. BGL and temperature not indicated. Non-RTC: repeat within about 15 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组——任何镇痛前的基线（启动协议前必须完成）：GCS 15（E4V5M6）；血压 132/78；脉搏 112 有力规则；呼吸 24 规则；皮肤红润温干；瞳孔等大有反应，4 mm；SpO2 室内空气 98%。血糖与体温无指征。非 RTC：约 15 分钟内复测。

expected.actionEn: GCS with components
expected.actionZh: GCS 及分项

expected.actionEn: BP by auscultation - baseline required before Entonox and before splinting
expected.actionZh: 听诊测血压——用 Entonox 前和夹板前均需基线值

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate/strength/rhythm
expected.actionZh: 脉搏频率/强度/节律

expected.actionEn: Respirations rate/depth/character
expected.actionZh: 呼吸频率/深度/性质

expected.actionEn: Skin hands-on - confirms the absence of shock
expected.actionZh: 动手查皮肤——确认无休克

expected.actionEn: Pupils
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔

expected.actionEn: SpO2 including oxygen saturation before Entonox use, as the guideline requires
expected.actionZh: SpO2——按指南要求，使用 Entonox 前必须有血氧饱和度

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY. ACTOR: general - fit athlete, no recent illness; CNS - no head strike, no dizziness, no numbness or tingling in the foot; respiratory - no SOB, no asthma (relevant to Entonox); cardiovascular - heart racing from pain; GI/GU - no abdominal pain, no history of ulcers or GI bleeding (relevant to ibuprofen); integumentary - no open wound over the fracture; musculoskeletal - right thigh only, no previous fractures; endocrine - no diabetes; EENT - no facial injury, no ear problems, no recent diving (relevant to Entonox).
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP。患者演员：整体——运动员体格良好、近期无疾病；中枢神经——头部未撞击、无头晕、足部无麻木刺痛；呼吸——无气促、无哮喘（与 Entonox 相关）；心血管——因疼痛心跳快；消化/泌尿——无腹痛、无溃疡或消化道出血史（与布洛芬相关）；皮肤——骨折处无开放伤口；肌肉骨骼——仅右大腿受伤、无既往骨折；内分泌——无糖尿病；眼耳鼻喉——面部无损伤、耳部无异常、近期未潜水（与 Entonox 相关）。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——整体健康

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS (distal neuro symptoms)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——中枢神经（远端神经症状）

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory (asthma/COPD screen before Entonox)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——呼吸（用 Entonox 前筛查哮喘/慢阻肺）

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——心血管

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU (ulcer and GI bleed screen before ibuprofen)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——消化/泌尿（用布洛芬前筛查溃疡与消化道出血）

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary (open vs closed fracture)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——皮肤（开放性还是闭合性骨折）

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——肌肉骨骼

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——内分泌

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——眼耳鼻喉

phases.infoEn: Head-to-toe: head/neck - no injury, no midline tenderness, NEXUS negative; chest - no injury, clear and equal 6 sites; abdomen - soft, non-tender; back - no tenderness or deformity on a careful check; lower extremities - right mid-thigh angulation, swelling and shortening; distal pulses, sensation and toe movement PRESENT and to be rechecked before and after splinting; left leg normal; upper extremities - no injury, CSM intact bilaterally.
phases.infoZh: 从头到脚：头颈——无损伤、无中线压痛、NEXUS 阴性；胸部——无损伤、6 点听诊清晰对称；腹部——软、无压痛；背部——仔细检查无压痛无畸形；下肢——右大腿中段成角、肿胀、缩短；远端脉搏、感觉与脚趾活动均存在，夹板前后须复查；左腿正常；上肢——无损伤、双侧 CSM 完好。

expected.actionEn: Head/neck exam confirming NEXUS-negative status
expected.actionZh: 头颈查体确认 NEXUS 阴性

expected.actionEn: Chest exam with 6-site auscultation
expected.actionZh: 胸部查体并 6 点听诊

expected.actionEn: Abdomen exam
expected.actionZh: 腹部查体

expected.actionEn: Back exam
expected.actionZh: 背部查体

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities incl hips/pelvis and documented distal CSM in the injured leg, compared with the uninjured side
expected.actionZh: 下肢（含髋与骨盆）并记录患肢远端 CSM，与健侧对比

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities with CSM
expected.actionZh: 上肢及远端 CSM

phases.infoEn: SEQUENCE IS THE WHOLE POINT OF THIS STATION. 1) Assess distal circulation, sensation and function. 2) Apply cold if appropriate, 10 minutes on and 5 off. 3) GIVE ANALGESIA BEFORE MOVING OR SPLINTING - PCP: acetaminophen 500-1000 mg PO and ibuprofen 300-400 mg PO, PLUS Entonox self-administered (invert the cylinder 3 times, ventilate the treatment area; contraindications: inability to comply, ALOC, pneumothorax, inhalation injury, decompression sickness, air embolism, nitroglycerin in the last 5 minutes). EMR: Entonox only. 4) Patient supine with the injured leg in line with the body. 5) Apply the traction splint using STAPLES: Size, Thigh strap, Ankle harness above the malleoli, Padding, Lbs of traction (closed mid-shaft = 10 percent of body weight to a MAXIMUM of 15 lbs / 7 kg; open mid-shaft = maximum 5 lbs), Elevate the bottom of the Sager to align neutral, Straps - three elasticized straps, blanket between the legs and legs strapped together. 6) NEVER release traction once applied. 7) Reassess distal pulses after splinting and with every movement, correcting traction as needed.
phases.infoZh: 本站的核心就是顺序。1）评估远端循环、感觉与活动。2）适当时冰敷，敷 10 分钟停 5 分钟。3）在移动或夹板之前先给镇痛——PCP：对乙酰氨基酚 500-1000 mg 口服加布洛芬 300-400 mg 口服，再加患者自控吸入 Entonox（气瓶倒转 3 次、保证治疗区通风；禁忌：无法配合、意识改变、气胸、吸入性损伤、减压病、空气栓塞、5 分钟内用过硝酸甘油）。EMR：仅 Entonox。4）患者仰卧，患肢与躯干成一直线。5）按 STAPLES 上牵引夹板：Size 量长度、Thigh 大腿带、Ankle 踝部吊带置于踝骨上方、Padding 加衬垫、Lbs 牵引重量（闭合股骨干=体重的 10%，上限 15 磅/7 kg；开放股骨干=最多 5 磅）、Elevate 抬高 Sager 尾端使其与腿保持中立对线、Straps 三条弹性绑带并在两腿间垫毯后把双腿绑在一起。6）牵引一旦施加绝不可放松。7）夹板后及每次移动时复查远端脉搏，必要时调整牵引。

expected.actionEn: Initiate the Pain Management protocol with baseline vitals complete and contraindications ruled out for each drug
expected.actionZh: 在基线生命体征完成、逐药排除禁忌后启动疼痛管理协议

expected.actionEn: Give analgesia BEFORE any movement, realignment or splinting - delaying Entonox until after fracture management is a 100% error
expected.actionZh: 在任何移动、复位或夹板之前给镇痛——把 Entonox 拖到骨折处理之后是 100% 级错误

expected.actionEn: Administer the drugs with the 6 rights (PCP: acetaminophen 1000 mg PO + ibuprofen 400 mg PO + Entonox; EMR: Entonox, cylinder inverted 3 times)
expected.actionZh: 按六项核对给药（PCP：对乙酰氨基酚 1000 mg+布洛芬 400 mg 口服+Entonox；EMR：Entonox，气瓶倒转 3 次）

expected.actionEn: Apply the traction splint by STAPLES with the correct traction weight (10 percent of body weight, maximum 15 lbs for a closed fracture) and never release it
expected.actionZh: 按 STAPLES 上牵引夹板并使用正确牵引重量（体重 10%，闭合骨折上限 15 磅），且绝不放松

expected.actionEn: Reassess distal circulation, sensation and function before and after splinting and after every move
expected.actionZh: 夹板前后及每次移动后复查远端循环、感觉与活动

expected.actionEn: Apply cold appropriately (10 minutes on, 5 minutes off) without impairing distal circulation
expected.actionZh: 正确冰敷（敷 10 分钟停 5 分钟）且不影响远端循环

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs, traction and distal CSM after every movement - the guideline specifically says traction must be reassessed and corrected with each movement and each set of vitals. Set 2 (after analgesia and splinting, on the cot): GCS 15; BP 126/76; pulse 92 strong regular; respirations 18; skin pink warm dry; pupils equal reactive; SpO2 98% RA; pain down from 10/10 to 4/10; dorsalis pedis and posterior tibial pulses still present, sensation and toe movement intact.
phases.infoZh: 每次移动后复评 ABC、牵引和远端 CSM——指南明确要求每次移动和每组生命体征时都要复查并校正牵引。第 2 组（镇痛与夹板后、已上担架床）：GCS 15；血压 126/76；脉搏 92 有力规则；呼吸 18；皮肤红润温干；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 室内空气 98%；疼痛由 10/10 降至 4/10；足背与胫后动脉搏动仍可及，感觉与脚趾活动完好。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and all interventions after each major move
expected.actionZh: 每次大移动后复评 ABC 与全部处置

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within the non-RTC interval
expected.actionZh: 在非 RTC 时限内完成第二组完整生命体征

expected.actionEn: Reassess and correct traction with every movement and every set of vitals
expected.actionZh: 每次移动和每组生命体征时复查并校正牵引

expected.actionEn: Reassess the pain score and continue Entonox to effect
expected.actionZh: 复评疼痛评分并按效果继续使用 Entonox

phases.infoEn: Non-critical: notify the receiving facility. Hand-off must state the traction weight applied, the analgesia given with times, and that distal CSM has been intact throughout. PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 非危重：通知接收医院。交接须说明所加牵引重量、镇痛用药及时间，以及远端 CSM 全程完好。5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: Notify the receiving facility
expected.actionZh: 向接收医院预报

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off with analgesia times and doses, traction weight and neurovascular status
expected.actionZh: 完整交接：镇痛时间与剂量、牵引重量、神经血管状态

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确 PCR

criticalPitfallsEn: Delaying Entonox until after realignment or fracture management when acetaminophen and ibuprofen have been given - 100% (Appendix A, item 6)
Giving acetaminophen and ibuprofen but no Entonox when indicated - 25%; giving only one of the two orals plus Entonox - 10%
Giving Entonox but omitting acetaminophen and ibuprofen when indicated (PCP) - 10%
Applying more than 15 lbs of traction, or releasing traction once applied - fracture management failure 25%
Not checking distal circulation, sensation and function before and after splinting - explicit 15% fracture-management deduction
Immobilizing the spine on a NEXUS-negative patient - non-indicated skill causing delay
criticalPitfallsZh: 已给对乙酰氨基酚和布洛芬，却把 Entonox 拖到复位或骨折处理之后——扣 100%（附录 A 第 6 条）
给了对乙酰氨基酚和布洛芬却在有指征时不给 Entonox——扣 25%；两种口服药只给其一再加 Entonox——扣 10%
给了 Entonox 却在有指征时不给对乙酰氨基酚和布洛芬（PCP）——扣 10%
牵引重量超过 15 磅，或施加牵引后又放松——骨折处理失分 25%
夹板前后不查远端循环、感觉与活动——评分手册明列扣 15%
对 NEXUS 阴性患者做脊柱固定——非指征操作并造成延误
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR performs the same traction splint and the same sequencing, but analgesia is Entonox only - acetaminophen and ibuprofen are not in EMR scope. The Appendix A pain-management weightings that involve the oral agents therefore do not apply to EMR; what still applies in full is giving Entonox BEFORE fracture management. No Functional Enquiry.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR 使用同样的牵引夹板和同样的顺序，但镇痛只有 Entonox——对乙酰氨基酚和布洛芬不在 EMR 范围内。因此附录 A 中涉及口服药的疼痛管理权重不适用于 EMR；仍然完全适用的是：Entonox 必须在骨折处理之前给。无功能问诊。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP uses the full three-drug ladder: acetaminophen 500-1000 mg PO and ibuprofen 300-400 mg PO on-boarded early (they take 30-60 minutes to work), with Entonox covering the splinting itself. PCP also completes the 9-system Functional Enquiry. IV access is not required for an isolated stable femur fracture with no shock.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 使用完整三联镇痛阶梯：尽早口服对乙酰氨基酚 500-1000 mg 和布洛芬 300-400 mg（起效需 30-60 分钟），夹板操作本身由 Entonox 覆盖。PCP 还需完成 9 系统功能问诊。孤立性、无休克的稳定股骨骨折不需要建立静脉通路。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 19-year-old male with an isolated closed mid-shaft right femur fracture, sustained at about 1414 when an opponent's knee struck the outside of his thigh during a soccer game. He heard a crack, dropped, and has not moved the leg since; no head strike, no loss of consciousness, no neck or back pain, so he is NEXUS negative and we have not immobilized his spine. Initial vitals GCS 15, BP 132/78, pulse 112, resps 24, skin pink warm and dry with no signs of shock, SpO2 98% on room air, pain 10 out of 10; latest BP 126/76, pulse 92, pain now 4 out of 10. No medical history, no medications, no known allergies, ate at 1230. Treatments: manual stabilization, cold applied, acetaminophen 1000 milligrams and ibuprofen 400 milligrams orally at 1428 with Entonox self-administered from 1430, then a Sager traction splint applied at 12 pounds of traction, which is 10 percent of his body weight, and has not been released. Dorsalis pedis and posterior tibial pulses, sensation and toe movement have been present before and after splinting and at every reassessment.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 19 岁男性，孤立性右股骨干闭合骨折，约 14:14 在足球比赛中被对方球员膝盖撞击大腿外侧所致。他听到「咔」声后倒地，此后未活动患肢；头部未撞击、无意识丧失、无颈背疼痛，故 NEXUS 阴性，我们未做脊柱固定。首组生命体征 GCS 15、血压 132/78、脉搏 112、呼吸 24、皮肤红润温干无休克征象、SpO2 室内空气 98%，疼痛 10/10；末组血压 126/76、脉搏 92，疼痛降至 4/10。无既往史、无用药、无已知过敏，12:30 进食。处置：徒手固定、冰敷，14:28 口服对乙酰氨基酚 1000 mg 与布洛芬 400 mg，14:30 起自控吸入 Entonox，随后上 Sager 牵引夹板、牵引重量 12 磅（为其体重的 10%），此后未放松。夹板前后及每次复评时，足背与胫后动脉搏动、感觉和脚趾活动均正常。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Isolated closed mid-shaft right femur fracture, pain 10/10
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Opponent's knee struck outside of right thigh at ~1414 during soccer; audible crack, immediate collapse, leg not moved since; no head strike, no LOC, no neck/back pain (NEXUS negative)
pcrKeyPoints.pmhx: None; no bleeding disorder, no liver or GI disease
pcrKeyPoints.meds: None; no anticoagulants; no analgesics taken today
pcrKeyPoints.allergies: NKA; no NSAID or acetaminophen allergy
treatments: Manual stabilization, leg kept in line with the body
Cold applied 10 min on / 5 min off
PCP: acetaminophen 1000 mg PO + ibuprofen 400 mg PO at 1428, Entonox self-administered from 1430 (EMR: Entonox only)
Sager traction splint at 12 lbs (10% body weight) applied AFTER analgesia; traction not released
Distal CSM checked before, after and at every move
findings: Mid-thigh angulation, swelling and shortening; closed fracture
Distal pulses, sensation and toe movement intact throughout
No signs of shock: skin pink warm dry, BP 132/78
Pain 10/10 down to 4/10 after analgesia
Spine cleared clinically - NEXUS negative

scenarios.titleZh: 花生暴露后过敏性休克
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1915 hrs. Code 3 to a Thai restaurant in New Westminster. 24-year-old female with a known peanut allergy has an allergic reaction. Staff say she is having trouble breathing. Hospital is 9 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 19:15，Code 3 前往新西敏一家泰国餐厅。24 岁女性，已知花生过敏，出现过敏反应。店员称她呼吸困难。医院车程 9 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: caller says her face is swelling and she used to carry an EpiPen but does not have it tonight.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：报警人称她面部肿胀，她平时带 EpiPen 但今晚没带。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge; plan epinephrine, oxygen, salbutamol, BVM, early transport
expected.actionZh: 确认信息；准备肾上腺素、氧气、沙丁胺醇、球囊面罩，计划尽早转运

expected.actionEn: Recognize from dispatch this is likely an unstable anaphylaxis call
expected.actionZh: 从派遣信息即预判这很可能是不稳定的过敏性休克

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Busy restaurant, staff have cleared a path to a corner booth. The patient is slumped sideways in the booth, flushed, with obvious facial and lip swelling, audible wheeze and stridor. Her friend is beside her holding a plate of pad thai. Room temperature, no hazards. One patient.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：餐厅客满，店员已清出通往角落卡座的通道。患者侧歪在卡座上，面色潮红，面部及口唇明显肿胀，可闻及喘鸣和吸气性喉鸣。朋友在旁边端着一盘泰式炒河粉。室温正常，无危险源。单一患者。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (none), environment, nature of illness (allergic reaction / possible ongoing allergen), number of patients (1)
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（无）、环境、发病性质（过敏反应/可能仍在接触过敏原）、患者数量（1 名）

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜

expected.actionEn: First look: flushed, facial/lip swelling, audible stridor and wheeze, slumped posture
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：潮红、面唇肿胀、可闻及喉鸣与喘鸣、身体瘫软

expected.actionEn: Remove/stop the allergen exposure (clear the food away)
expected.actionZh: 移除/终止过敏原暴露（把食物拿开）

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: awake but drowsy, answers in one or two words, clutching her throat, says 'can't... breathe'. EXAMINER (give when assessed): airway - swollen, stridor present but she is still moving air; respirations 30, laboured with accessory muscle use and audible wheeze; radial pulse 130 weak. Skin: flushed with widespread urticaria (hives) over chest and arms, warm and moist. RBS: no trauma, no injection sites, no stinger. SpO2 88% RA. C-spine NOT indicated. UNSTABLE: anaphylaxis with respiratory distress and decreased LOC.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：清醒但嗜睡，只能一两个词回答，手抓喉咙，说「喘…不上气」。考官（评估时给出）：气道——肿胀、有喉鸣但仍有气流通过；呼吸 30 次/分、费力、动用辅助呼吸肌、可闻及喘鸣；桡动脉 130 次/分、细弱。皮肤：潮红，胸部和双臂广泛荨麻疹，温热潮湿。RBS：无外伤、无注射痕迹、无蜂刺。SpO2 室内空气 88%。无颈椎固定指征。不稳定：过敏性休克伴呼吸窘迫和意识下降。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: responds to Verbal, drowsy - a decreased LOC finding
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：对言语有反应、嗜睡——属意识下降

expected.actionEn: Verbalize c-spine not indicated (medical, no trauma)
expected.actionZh: 口述无颈椎固定指征（内科、无外伤）

expected.actionEn: Assess airway - identify swelling and stridor as an airway threat
expected.actionZh: 评估气道——识别肿胀与喉鸣为气道威胁

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing - rate, effort, accessory muscle use, wheeze
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸——频率、做功、辅助肌使用、喘鸣

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation - weak rapid radial pulse
expected.actionZh: 评估循环——桡动脉细速

expected.actionEn: Perform a modified rapid body survey looking for hives, stinger/injection site and other causes
expected.actionZh: 做改良快速查体，寻找荨麻疹、蜂刺/注射部位及其他原因

expected.actionEn: Note skin: flushed, urticaria, warm moist
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：潮红、荨麻疹、温热潮湿

expected.actionEn: High-flow oxygen 15 L NRB to target SpO2 at or above 94%
expected.actionZh: 高流量吸氧 15 L 非再吸入面罩，目标 SpO2≥94%

expected.actionEn: Position SUPINE to support blood pressure and do NOT walk the patient (per Anaphylaxis guideline)
expected.actionZh: 按过敏性休克指南置仰卧位以维持血压，且绝不让患者行走

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Anaphylaxis with respiratory distress and decreased LOC = UNSTABLE, RTC. Give epinephrine on scene then transport - do not delay for a full secondary survey. Ready to load within 15 minutes. Delegate crew to prep egress while you run the protocol.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。过敏性休克伴呼吸窘迫和意识下降=不稳定，RTC。现场给肾上腺素后转运——不要为完成完整二次评估而拖延。15 分钟内可装载。执行协议同时指派搭档准备撤离路线。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC and act with urgency
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC 并保持紧迫感

expected.actionEn: Epinephrine given on scene, then ready to load within 15 minutes
expected.actionZh: 现场给予肾上腺素后 15 分钟内可装载

expected.actionEn: Delegate crew members to prep egress (explicitly required by the Anaphylaxis guideline)
expected.actionZh: 指派搭档准备撤离通道（过敏性休克指南明确要求）

phases.infoEn: ACTOR / FRIEND ANSWERS (patient can only manage a few words; use the friend): ate pad thai, first mouthful about 8 minutes ago, told the server 'no peanuts'; itching and throat tightness within 2 minutes, then swelling. Known peanut anaphylaxis, two previous ER visits, one previous EpiPen use. Onset sudden, severity worst ever, no relief. PMHx: peanut anaphylaxis, mild asthma. Meds: salbutamol MDI prn, EpiPen (not with her, expired last month). Allergies: peanuts (anaphylaxis), shellfish (hives). LOI: the pad thai just now, water.
phases.infoZh: 患者/朋友回答（患者只能说几个词，主要问朋友）：吃了泰式炒河粉，第一口约在 8 分钟前，点餐时特意说过「不要花生」；2 分钟内出现瘙痒和喉咙发紧，随后肿胀。已知花生过敏性休克，曾两次进急诊，用过一次 EpiPen。起病突然，是历来最重的一次，无缓解。既往史：花生过敏性休克、轻度哮喘。用药：沙丁胺醇定量吸入剂按需、EpiPen（未随身，上月已过期）。过敏：花生（过敏性休克）、贝类（荨麻疹）。最后进食：刚才的炒河粉和水。

expected.actionEn: Establish chief complaint: difficulty breathing and throat swelling after eating
expected.actionZh: 确立主诉：进食后呼吸困难与咽喉肿胀

expected.actionEn: HxC/C with OPQRRRST/LOTARP: onset, allergen, time from exposure, progression, previous reactions, severity
expected.actionZh: 用 OPQRRRST/LOTARP 采集现病史：起病、过敏原、暴露到发病时间、进展、既往反应、严重程度

expected.actionEn: PMHx (peanut anaphylaxis, asthma)
expected.actionZh: 既往史（花生过敏性休克、哮喘）

expected.actionEn: Medications incl EpiPen availability and expiry
expected.actionZh: 用药史（含 EpiPen 是否随身及有效期）

expected.actionEn: Allergies with consequence detail
expected.actionZh: 过敏史及其后果细节

expected.actionEn: LOI - identifies the exposure
expected.actionZh: 最后进食——确定暴露源

expected.actionEn: Use the friend as a history source when the patient cannot speak
expected.actionZh: 患者说不了话时改由朋友提供病史

phases.infoEn: Set 1 - baseline BEFORE epinephrine (required before initiating a protocol): GCS 14 (E4 V4 M6, confused); BP 84/50; pulse 130 weak regular; respirations 30 laboured with wheeze; skin flushed, urticarial, warm moist; pupils equal reactive; SpO2 88% RA. BGL 6.1 if checked (altered LOC - reasonable). Temp not indicated. RTC interval 5-6 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组——给肾上腺素前的基线（启动协议前必须完成）：GCS 14（E4 V4 M6，言语错乱）；血压 84/50；脉搏 130 细弱规则；呼吸 30 费力伴喘鸣；皮肤潮红、有荨麻疹、温热潮湿；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 室内空气 88%。若测血糖为 6.1（意识改变，测血糖合理）。体温无指征。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟。

expected.actionEn: GCS with components (14: E4 V4 M6)
expected.actionZh: GCS 及分项（14：E4 V4 M6）

expected.actionEn: BP by auscultation - recognize BP under 90 systolic as an anaphylaxis instability criterion
expected.actionZh: 听诊测血压——识别收缩压低于 90 为过敏性休克不稳定标准

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate/strength/rhythm
expected.actionZh: 脉搏频率/强度/节律

expected.actionEn: Respirations rate/depth/character incl wheeze
expected.actionZh: 呼吸频率/深度/性质（含喘鸣）

expected.actionEn: Skin hands-on: temperature, colour, condition, extent of urticaria
expected.actionZh: 动手查皮肤：温度、颜色、状态、荨麻疹范围

expected.actionEn: Pupils
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔

expected.actionEn: SpO2 with calibration
expected.actionZh: SpO2 并校准

expected.actionEn: BGL - reasonable with altered LOC
expected.actionZh: 血糖——意识改变时合理

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, en route AFTER epinephrine, brief. ACTOR (improving, now able to talk): general - felt fine until dinner; CNS - felt faint, no headache; respiratory - throat tightness and wheeze, improving; cardiovascular - heart racing (expected after epinephrine); GI/GU - crampy abdominal pain and nausea; integumentary - itching and hives all over; musculoskeletal nil; endocrine nil; EENT - lip and tongue swelling, eyes itchy and puffy.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP，给肾上腺素后在途中简要完成。患者演员（好转，已能说话）：整体——晚餐前一切正常；中枢神经——曾觉眩晕、无头痛；呼吸——咽紧和喘鸣，正在好转；心血管——心跳快（用肾上腺素后预期表现）；消化/泌尿——腹部绞痛伴恶心；皮肤——全身瘙痒和风团；肌肉骨骼无；内分泌无；眼耳鼻喉——口唇及舌肿胀、眼痒浮肿。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——整体健康

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——中枢神经

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory (pertinent)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——呼吸（与主诉相关）

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——心血管

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU (abdominal cramps are an anaphylaxis sign)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——消化/泌尿（腹部绞痛属过敏性休克表现）

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary (urticaria)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——皮肤（荨麻疹）

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——肌肉骨骼

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——内分泌

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT (angioedema)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——眼耳鼻喉（血管性水肿）

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE head-to-toe: head/neck - lip and tongue swelling, stridor decreasing after epinephrine, no JVD; chest - expiratory wheeze in all fields on 6-site auscultation, improving after salbutamol; abdomen - soft, mild generalized tenderness; back - urticaria across the back; lower extremities - urticaria, CSM intact; upper extremities - urticaria, CSM intact.
phases.infoZh: 途中从头到脚：头颈——口唇及舌肿胀，用肾上腺素后喉鸣减轻，无颈静脉怒张；胸部——6 点听诊各野呼气相喘鸣，沙丁胺醇后好转；腹部——软，轻度弥漫压痛；背部——背部可见荨麻疹；下肢——荨麻疹，远端 CSM 完好；上肢——荨麻疹，远端 CSM 完好。

expected.actionEn: Head/neck exam incl airway swelling reassessment
expected.actionZh: 头颈查体（含气道肿胀复评）

expected.actionEn: Chest exam with 6-site auscultation, bilateral comparison
expected.actionZh: 胸部查体并 6 点听诊、双侧对比

expected.actionEn: Abdomen exam
expected.actionZh: 腹部查体

expected.actionEn: Back exam
expected.actionZh: 背部查体

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities
expected.actionZh: 下肢

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities
expected.actionZh: 上肢

phases.infoEn: ALL LEVELS: remove allergen, supine, high-flow O2, baseline vitals, then EPINEPHRINE 0.5 mg IM (adult) - there are no absolute contraindications in life-threatening anaphylaxis; may repeat every 5 minutes up to 3 times. Then transport and continue treatment en route. PCP ADDITIONS: vascular access and 20 mL/kg fluid bolus (max 2 L, reassess q500 mL) if still hypotensive; salbutamol by nebulizer or MDI for bronchospasm AFTER epinephrine has been given; diphenhydramine 25-50 mg to limit the histamine response. Note: epinephrine first - salbutamol or antihistamine INSTEAD of epinephrine is a major protocol error.
phases.infoZh: 各级别通用：移除过敏原、仰卧、高流量吸氧、完成基线生命体征，然后肌注肾上腺素 0.5 mg（成人）——危及生命的过敏性休克无绝对禁忌；可每 5 分钟重复，最多 3 次。随后转运并在途中继续治疗。PCP 追加：仍低血压时建立静脉通路并 20 mL/kg 补液（上限 2 升、每 500 mL 复评）；肾上腺素已给后再用沙丁胺醇雾化或定量吸入剂处理支气管痉挛；苯海拉明 25-50 mg 抑制组胺反应。注意：必须先给肾上腺素——用沙丁胺醇或抗组胺药替代肾上腺素属重大协议错误。

expected.actionEn: Initiate the Anaphylaxis protocol with correct indications (signs + exposure + instability) and baseline vitals done
expected.actionZh: 在指征正确（症状+暴露+不稳定）且基线生命体征已完成的前提下启动过敏性休克协议

expected.actionEn: Administer epinephrine 0.5 mg IM with the 6 rights, correct site (anterolateral thigh) and IM needle
expected.actionZh: 按六项核对肌注肾上腺素 0.5 mg，部位正确（大腿前外侧）并使用肌注针

expected.actionEn: Verbalize repeat dosing: may repeat 0.5 mg IM every 5 minutes up to 3 doses if no improvement
expected.actionZh: 口述重复给药：无改善时可每 5 分钟重复 0.5 mg 肌注，最多 3 次

expected.actionEn: PCP: salbutamol for bronchospasm only AFTER epinephrine; diphenhydramine 25-50 mg; IV with fluid bolus if still hypotensive
expected.actionZh: PCP：支气管痉挛在肾上腺素之后再用沙丁胺醇；苯海拉明 25-50 mg；仍低血压时静脉补液

expected.actionEn: Do not allow the patient to stand or walk to the stretcher
expected.actionZh: 不允许患者站立或自行走到担架床

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs and interventions 5 minutes after epinephrine and after each move. Set 2 (5 minutes post-epinephrine, en route): GCS 15 (E4V5M6); BP 106/68; pulse 118 stronger; respirations 22, wheeze reduced, stridor resolved; skin still flushed with fading hives, warm dry; pupils equal; SpO2 96% on 15 L. Improving - document the response; if it had NOT improved, a second 0.5 mg IM dose at 5 minutes is required.
phases.infoZh: 肾上腺素后 5 分钟及每次移动后复评 ABC 与各项处置。第 2 组（给药后 5 分钟，途中）：GCS 15（E4V5M6）；血压 106/68；脉搏 118 较前有力；呼吸 22，喘鸣减轻、喉鸣消失；皮肤仍潮红、风团渐退、温干；瞳孔等大；SpO2 15 L 下 96%。病情好转——记录治疗反应；若未好转，须在 5 分钟时追加第二剂 0.5 mg 肌注。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and all interventions after epinephrine and after each move
expected.actionZh: 给药后及每次移动后复评 ABC 与全部处置

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 5-6 minutes and interpret the response to epinephrine
expected.actionZh: 5-6 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征，并解读对肾上腺素的反应

expected.actionEn: Verbalize the plan for a repeat dose if deterioration or no improvement occurs
expected.actionZh: 口述若病情恶化或无改善的重复给药计划

phases.infoEn: Critical patient - notify the hospital en route (allergic airway). Structured hand-off with drug times and response; PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 危重患者——途中通知医院（过敏性气道问题）。结构化交接，含给药时间与反应；5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: En-route notification for a critical patient
expected.actionZh: 危重患者途中预报

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off with epinephrine time, dose, route and response
expected.actionZh: 完整交接（肾上腺素时间、剂量、途径与反应）

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确 PCR

criticalPitfallsEn: Giving salbutamol or diphenhydramine instead of / before epinephrine - major protocol error up to 100%
Initiating the protocol without a baseline set of vital signs - 100%
Walking the patient to the stretcher or sitting her up when hypotensive - 100% (guideline says supine, do not walk)
Not reassessing at 5 minutes and missing the indication for a repeat epinephrine dose - major delay in subsequent doses, 100%
Treating as non-RTC and completing a full on-scene secondary survey - transport category error, 25%
criticalPitfallsZh: 用沙丁胺醇或苯海拉明替代肾上腺素、或抢在其之前给——重大协议错误，最高扣 100%
未做基线生命体征就启动协议——扣 100%
让低血压患者自行走向担架或坐起——扣 100%（指南要求仰卧、禁止行走）
5 分钟不复评、错过重复给肾上腺素的指征——后续剂量重大延误，扣 100%
当作非 RTC、在现场做完整二次评估——转运分类错误，扣 25%
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR gives epinephrine 0.5 mg IM (repeat q5 min up to 3 doses), oxygen, supine positioning and rapid transport. EMR does NOT give diphenhydramine or IV fluids; salbutamol is within EMR scope for bronchospasm but only after epinephrine. No Functional Enquiry.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR 给肾上腺素 0.5 mg 肌注（每 5 分钟重复，最多 3 次）、吸氧、仰卧位并快速转运。EMR 不给苯海拉明和静脉补液；沙丁胺醇在 EMR 范围内可用于支气管痉挛，但必须在肾上腺素之后。无功能问诊。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds vascular access with a 20 mL/kg bolus (max 2 L, reassess q500 mL) for persistent hypotension, salbutamol after epinephrine for bronchospasm, diphenhydramine 25-50 mg, and the 9-system Functional Enquiry en route.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 增加静脉通路与 20 mL/kg 补液（上限 2 升、每 500 mL 复评）处理持续低血压、肾上腺素后用沙丁胺醇处理支气管痉挛、苯海拉明 25-50 mg，以及途中 9 系统功能问诊。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 24-year-old female with known peanut anaphylaxis, chief complaint of throat swelling and difficulty breathing about 8 minutes after eating pad thai. On our arrival she had stridor, wheeze, facial and lip angioedema, widespread urticaria, GCS 14, BP 84/50, pulse 130 weak, resps 30 laboured, SpO2 88% on room air, BGL 6.1. She received epinephrine 0.5 milligrams IM to the left anterolateral thigh at 1922, high-flow oxygen, supine positioning, salbutamol by nebulizer and diphenhydramine 50 milligrams, with an IV and saline running. Five minutes post-epinephrine she is GCS 15, BP 106/68, pulse 118, resps 22, SpO2 96% on 15 litres, stridor resolved. History of peanut anaphylaxis and mild asthma, uses a salbutamol inhaler, her EpiPen was expired and not with her, allergic to peanuts and shellfish.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 24 岁女性，已知花生过敏性休克，主诉为进食泰式炒河粉约 8 分钟后出现咽喉肿胀和呼吸困难。我们到场时有喉鸣、喘鸣、面唇血管性水肿、全身荨麻疹，GCS 14、血压 84/50、脉搏 130 细弱、呼吸 30 费力、SpO2 室内空气 88%、血糖 6.1。19:22 于左大腿前外侧肌注肾上腺素 0.5 mg，并给高流量吸氧、仰卧位、沙丁胺醇雾化和苯海拉明 50 mg，已建立静脉通路补液。给药后 5 分钟：GCS 15、血压 106/68、脉搏 118、呼吸 22、SpO2 15 升下 96%，喉鸣消失。既往花生过敏性休克及轻度哮喘，使用沙丁胺醇吸入剂，EpiPen 已过期且未随身，对花生和贝类过敏。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Throat swelling and difficulty breathing after peanut exposure (anaphylaxis)
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Ate pad thai ~8 min prior despite requesting no peanuts; itching and throat tightness within 2 min, progressive swelling, worst reaction to date; 2 previous ER visits
pcrKeyPoints.meds: Salbutamol MDI prn; EpiPen (expired, not carried)

findings: Stridor, wheeze, facial/lip angioedema, widespread urticaria

Abdominal cramping and nausea

scenarios.titleEn: Cardiac Chest Pain - ASA and Nitroglycerin
scenarios.titleZh: 心源性胸痛——阿司匹林与硝酸甘油
scenarios.dispatchEn: 0640 hrs. Code 3 to a townhouse complex in Coquitlam. 62-year-old male with central chest pain that woke him from sleep. His wife made the call. Hospital with a cath lab is 14 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 06:40，Code 3 前往高贵林一处联排住宅。62 岁男性因胸骨后疼痛从睡梦中痛醒。其妻报警。设有心导管室的医院车程 14 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: he is conscious, sweating, and has not taken anything for the pain. No prescribed nitroglycerin in the house.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：患者清醒、出汗，尚未服用任何止痛药物。家中没有处方硝酸甘油。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge; plan ASA, nitroglycerin, oxygen, cot to the patient, minimal-exertion approach
expected.actionZh: 确认；准备阿司匹林、硝酸甘油、氧气，把担架床推到患者身边，采取减少活动的策略

expected.actionEn: Anticipate a time-critical cardiac call and plan early transport with hospital notification
expected.actionZh: 预判为时间敏感的心脏事件，计划尽早转运并通知医院

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Wife meets you at the door and leads you upstairs to the bedroom. Warm room, well lit, stairs are the only egress challenge - 14 steps, narrow turn. The patient sits on the edge of the bed, grey and diaphoretic, fist clenched over his sternum. One patient. No hazards, no pets, no smoking materials.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：妻子在门口迎接并带你上楼进卧室。房间温暖、照明良好，唯一的搬运难点是楼梯——14 级台阶，转角狭窄。患者坐在床沿，面色灰白、大汗，握拳按在胸骨上。单一患者。无危险源、无宠物、无吸烟物品。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (stair egress), environment, nature of illness (chest pain), number of patients (1)
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（楼梯搬运）、环境、发病性质（胸痛）、患者数量（1 名）

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜

expected.actionEn: First look: grey, diaphoretic, clenched fist over sternum (Levine sign)
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：面色灰白、大汗、握拳压胸骨（Levine 征）

expected.actionEn: Plan the stair egress early and bring equipment to the patient rather than walking him
expected.actionZh: 尽早规划下楼方案，把装备带到患者身边而不是让他走动

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: alert and oriented, speaking in short sentences because of the pain, says it feels like a weight on his chest. EXAMINER (give when assessed): airway clear; respirations 22, slightly laboured, no wheeze; radial pulse 96, regular, normal strength. Skin: pale, cool, diaphoretic. Modified rapid body survey: no trauma, no edema, no obvious abnormality; abdomen soft. SpO2 96% RA. C-spine not indicated. UNSTABLE by BC criteria: suspected cardiac chest pain.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：清醒、定向力正常，因疼痛只能短句说话，形容像有重物压在胸口。考官（评估时给出）：气道通畅；呼吸 22 次/分、略费力、无喘鸣；桡动脉 96 次/分、规则、强度正常。皮肤：苍白、发凉、大汗。改良快速查体：无外伤、无水肿、无明显异常；腹部软。SpO2 室内空气 96%。无颈椎固定指征。按 BC 标准属不稳定：疑似心源性胸痛。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: Alert
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：Alert

expected.actionEn: Verbalize c-spine not indicated (medical presentation)
expected.actionZh: 口述无颈椎固定指征（内科表现）

expected.actionEn: Assess airway
expected.actionZh: 评估气道

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing rate, depth and effort
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸频率、深度与做功

expected.actionEn: Assess radial pulse rate, strength and regularity
expected.actionZh: 评估桡动脉频率、强度与节律

expected.actionEn: Perform a modified rapid body survey appropriate to a medical patient
expected.actionZh: 按内科患者做适当的改良快速查体

expected.actionEn: Note skin: pale cool diaphoretic
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：苍白、发凉、大汗

expected.actionEn: Titrate oxygen only to maintain SpO2 at or above 94% - at 96% RA supplemental oxygen is not required; verbalize the decision
expected.actionZh: 仅按维持 SpO2≥94% 滴定给氧——室内空气 96% 时无需吸氧，需口述该决策

expected.actionEn: Keep at rest in a position of comfort; limit all patient movement and exertion
expected.actionZh: 保持休息于舒适体位；限制一切活动和用力

expected.actionEn: Administer ASA 160 mg chewed and swallowed after the rapid body survey (ASA is the one drug not requiring vitals first)
expected.actionZh: 快速查体后给阿司匹林 160 mg 嚼服（唯一无需先测生命体征的药物）

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Suspected cardiac chest pain = UNSTABLE, RTC. The guideline says transport immediately if able; if not, delegate crew to prep egress. Ready to load within 15 minutes. Give nitroglycerin, then transport after the first dose if not already moving.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。疑似心源性胸痛=不稳定，RTC。指南要求：能立即转运就立即转运；不能则指派搭档准备撤离路线。15 分钟内可装载。给硝酸甘油，若尚未出发则在第一剂后转运。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC and act with urgency
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC 并保持紧迫感

expected.actionEn: Ready to load within 15 minutes; carry the patient down the stairs, do not let him walk
expected.actionZh: 15 分钟内可装载；抬患者下楼，绝不让其自行走动

expected.actionEn: Delegate the partner to prep egress and the stair chair while you run the protocol
expected.actionZh: 执行协议时指派搭档准备撤离路线和楼梯椅

phases.infoEn: ACTOR ANSWERS: woke at 0615 with central chest pressure. O - at rest, woke him. P - nothing makes it better, deep breathing does not change it. Q - heavy pressure, like a band. R - radiates to the left jaw and down the left arm. R (relief) - none. R (recurrence) - had two similar milder episodes with exertion this week that settled with rest. S - 8/10. T - constant for 25 minutes. Associated: nausea, sweating, short of breath. PMHx: hypertension, high cholesterol, ex-smoker (quit 3 years, 30 pack-years), father died of MI at 58. Meds: amlodipine 5 mg, rosuvastatin 10 mg. NO erectile dysfunction medication - specifically denies Viagra, Levitra or Cialis. Allergies: none known. LOI: dinner at 1900 last night, nothing since.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员回答：06:15 因胸骨后压迫感痛醒。O——静息状态下发作、把他痛醒。P——没有任何方式能缓解，深呼吸不影响疼痛。Q——沉重压迫感，像被箍住。R——放射至左下颌和左上肢。R（缓解）——无。R（复发）——本周有过两次较轻的活动后发作，休息后自行缓解。S——8/10。T——持续 25 分钟。伴随症状：恶心、出汗、气促。既往史：高血压、高血脂、戒烟 3 年（吸烟史 30 包年），父亲 58 岁死于心梗。用药：氨氯地平 5 mg、瑞舒伐他汀 10 mg。无勃起功能障碍用药——明确否认使用万艾可、艾力达或希爱力。过敏：无已知过敏。最后进食：昨晚 19:00 晚餐，之后未进食。

expected.actionEn: Establish chief complaint: central chest pain
expected.actionZh: 确立主诉：胸骨后疼痛

expected.actionEn: Full OPQRRRST pain assessment including radiation, recurrence and severity
expected.actionZh: 完整 OPQRRRST 疼痛评估，包括放射、复发和严重程度

expected.actionEn: Obtain a 0-10 pain score
expected.actionZh: 采集 0-10 疼痛评分

expected.actionEn: PMHx with cardiac risk factors and time scales
expected.actionZh: 既往史（含心血管危险因素与时间跨度）

expected.actionEn: Medications - and specifically screen for Viagra/Levitra in 24 h or Cialis in 48 h before nitroglycerin
expected.actionZh: 用药史——给硝酸甘油前必须专门筛查 24 小时内万艾可/艾力达或 48 小时内希爱力

expected.actionEn: Allergies incl aspirin sensitivity before giving ASA
expected.actionZh: 过敏史（给阿司匹林前须问阿司匹林过敏）

expected.actionEn: LOI
expected.actionZh: 最后进食

phases.infoEn: Set 1 - baseline BEFORE nitroglycerin: GCS 15 (E4V5M6); BP 148/92; pulse 96 regular; respirations 22; skin pale cool diaphoretic; pupils equal reactive; SpO2 96% RA. BGL not routinely indicated; temperature not indicated. Systolic is above 110 and HR is between 50 and 150, so nitroglycerin is not contraindicated on vitals. RTC interval 5-6 minutes; repeat vitals before EVERY nitroglycerin dose.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组——给硝酸甘油前的基线：GCS 15（E4V5M6）；血压 148/92；脉搏 96 规则；呼吸 22；皮肤苍白发凉大汗；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 室内空气 96%。血糖常规无指征；体温无指征。收缩压高于 110、心率在 50-150 之间，故生命体征方面无硝酸甘油禁忌。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟；每次给硝酸甘油前都必须复测生命体征。

expected.actionZh: GCS 及分项

expected.actionEn: BP by auscultation - confirm systolic above 110 before nitroglycerin
expected.actionZh: 听诊测血压——给硝酸甘油前确认收缩压高于 110

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate/strength/rhythm - confirm HR is not under 50 or over 150
expected.actionZh: 脉搏频率/强度/节律——确认心率不低于 50 且不高于 150

expected.actionEn: Respirations rate/depth/character
expected.actionZh: 呼吸频率/深度/性质

expected.actionEn: Skin hands-on
expected.actionZh: 动手查皮肤

expected.actionEn: Pupils
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔

expected.actionZh: SpO2 并校准

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, en route. ACTOR: general - well until this week; CNS - no syncope, no headache; respiratory - short of breath with the pain, no cough, no orthopnea; cardiovascular - chest pressure with radiation, no palpitations, no ankle swelling, two exertional episodes this week; GI/GU - nauseated, no vomiting, no indigestion pattern; integumentary - sweating heavily; musculoskeletal - no chest wall injury, pain not reproducible on palpation; endocrine - no diabetes; EENT - nil.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP，途中完成。患者演员：整体——本周之前一直健康；中枢神经——无晕厥、无头痛；呼吸——疼痛时气促、无咳嗽、无端坐呼吸；心血管——胸部压迫感伴放射、无心悸、无踝部水肿、本周有两次活动后发作；消化/泌尿——恶心、无呕吐、不像消化不良的规律；皮肤——大量出汗；肌肉骨骼——胸壁无外伤、按压不能复现疼痛；内分泌——无糖尿病；眼耳鼻喉——无异常。

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——眼耳鼻喉

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE head-to-toe: head/neck - no JVD, trachea midline; chest - no chest wall tenderness, pain NOT reproducible on palpation, air entry equal and clear in all 6 sites, no crackles; abdomen - soft, non-tender; back - no findings; lower extremities - no pedal edema, pulses equal; upper extremities - pulses equal bilaterally, no deficit.
phases.infoZh: 途中从头到脚：头颈——无颈静脉怒张、气管居中；胸部——胸壁无压痛、按压不能复现疼痛、6 个听诊点空气进入对称且清晰、无湿啰音；腹部——软、无压痛；背部——无异常；下肢——无足部水肿、双侧动脉搏动对称；上肢——双侧搏动对称、无功能缺损。

expected.actionEn: Head/neck exam incl JVD assessment
expected.actionZh: 头颈查体（含颈静脉怒张评估）

expected.actionEn: Chest exam with 6-site auscultation; palpate to test reproducibility of the pain
expected.actionZh: 胸部查体并 6 点听诊；触诊检验疼痛可否复现

expected.actionEn: Abdomen exam
expected.actionZh: 腹部查体

expected.actionEn: Back exam
expected.actionZh: 背部查体

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities incl pedal edema and pulses
expected.actionZh: 下肢（含足部水肿与动脉搏动）

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities incl bilateral pulse comparison
expected.actionZh: 上肢（含双侧脉搏对比）

phases.infoEn: Cardiac Chest Pain protocol, all levels: position of comfort, limit movement, oxygen only to keep SpO2 at or above 94%, ASA 160 mg PO chewed after the RBS, initiate transport, history and baseline vitals, then NITROGLYCERIN 0.4 mg SL every 3-5 minutes provided systolic BP stays above 110, to a maximum of 3 doses in any 30-minute period, until pain free. Repeat vital signs before EVERY dose. Do not shake the spray; verbalize priming. If pain persists beyond 3 doses or systolic falls below 110, give Entonox 5 minutes after the last nitroglycerin dose. PCP ADDITIONS: vascular access with running fluid; consider dimenhydrinate 1 mg/kg to a max 50 mg for nausea.
phases.infoZh: 心源性胸痛协议（各级别通用）：舒适体位、限制活动、按维持 SpO2≥94% 给氧、快速查体后阿司匹林 160 mg 嚼服、启动转运、采集病史与基线生命体征，然后硝酸甘油 0.4 mg 舌下含服，每 3-5 分钟一次，前提是收缩压持续高于 110，30 分钟内最多 3 剂，直至无痛。每次给药前都要复测生命体征。喷雾剂给药前不要摇晃，需口述预喷排气。若 3 剂后疼痛持续或收缩压降至 110 以下，在最后一剂硝酸甘油后 5 分钟给 Entonox。PCP 追加：建立静脉通路并持续输液；恶心可考虑苯海拉明类止吐药茶苯海明 1 mg/kg（上限 50 mg）。

expected.actionEn: Initiate the Cardiac Chest Pain protocol with correct indications and sequence (ASA after RBS, nitroglycerin after baseline vitals)
expected.actionZh: 按正确指征与顺序启动心源性胸痛协议（阿司匹林在快速查体后，硝酸甘油在基线生命体征后）

expected.actionEn: ASA 160 mg PO chewed with 6 rights; rule out allergy, active GI bleed/peptic ulcer, inability to swallow, prior dose taken
expected.actionZh: 阿司匹林 160 mg 嚼服并六项核对；排除过敏、活动性消化道出血/溃疡、无法吞咽、到场前已服用

expected.actionEn: Nitroglycerin 0.4 mg SL with contraindications ruled out (SBP under 110, HR under 50 or over 150, nitrate allergy, PDE5 inhibitor use) and vitals repeated before each dose
expected.actionZh: 硝酸甘油 0.4 mg 舌下并排除禁忌（收缩压低于 110、心率低于 50 或高于 150、硝酸盐过敏、PDE5 抑制剂用药），每剂前复测生命体征

expected.actionEn: Verbalize the maximum of 3 nitroglycerin doses in 30 minutes and the Entonox rule (5 minutes after the last nitroglycerin dose)
expected.actionZh: 口述 30 分钟内硝酸甘油最多 3 剂，以及 Entonox 规则（末次硝酸甘油后 5 分钟）

expected.actionEn: PCP: vascular access with running fluid; consider dimenhydrinate for nausea
expected.actionZh: PCP：建立静脉通路并持续输液；恶心时考虑茶苯海明

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs and pain after every dose and every move. Set 2 (after 2 doses of nitroglycerin, en route): GCS 15; BP 122/78; pulse 88 regular; respirations 18; skin pink, warm, drying; pupils equal reactive; SpO2 97% RA; pain down from 8/10 to 3/10. Note the systolic remains above 110, so a third dose is permitted if pain persists. If the candidate does not recheck BP before dosing, EXAMINER drops the BP to 96/60 to test whether they withhold the next dose.
phases.infoZh: 每次给药和每次移动后复评 ABC 与疼痛。第 2 组（给两剂硝酸甘油后，途中）：GCS 15；血压 122/78；脉搏 88 规则；呼吸 18；皮肤转红润、温暖、汗渐干；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 室内空气 97%；疼痛由 8/10 降至 3/10。注意收缩压仍高于 110，故疼痛持续时可给第三剂。若考生给药前不复测血压，考官将把血压改为 96/60，检验其是否会停止下一剂。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and all interventions after each dose and each move
expected.actionZh: 每次给药与每次移动后复评 ABC 及全部处置

expected.actionEn: Full second set of vitals within 5-6 minutes and before the next nitroglycerin dose
expected.actionZh: 在 5-6 分钟内且在下一剂硝酸甘油之前完成第二组完整生命体征

expected.actionEn: Reassess the pain score after each dose and titrate to pain-free
expected.actionZh: 每剂后复评疼痛评分，滴定至无痛

expected.actionEn: Withhold nitroglycerin if systolic falls below 110 and switch to the Entonox pathway
expected.actionZh: 收缩压降至 110 以下即停用硝酸甘油，转为 Entonox 路径

phases.infoEn: Critical patient - notify the receiving facility en route (possible STEMI, cath lab). Hand-off with all drug times, doses and pain response; PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 危重患者——途中通知接收医院（可能为 STEMI，需心导管室）。交接需含全部给药时间、剂量与疼痛反应；5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: En-route notification of a possible acute coronary syndrome
expected.actionZh: 途中预报疑似急性冠脉综合征

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off with ASA and nitroglycerin times, doses and BP trend
expected.actionZh: 完整交接：阿司匹林与硝酸甘油的时间、剂量及血压变化

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确 PCR

vitalsSets.timeHint: after 2 doses of nitroglycerin, en route

criticalPitfallsEn: Giving nitroglycerin without a baseline set of vital signs, or without rechecking BP before each dose - 100% (Protocols)
Not screening for Viagra/Levitra in the last 24 h or Cialis in the last 48 h before nitroglycerin - failure to rule out contraindications, up to 100%
Letting the patient walk down the stairs to the ambulance - exertion in cardiac chest pain, overall patient care deduction up to 100%
Applying high-flow oxygen when SpO2 is 96% - oxygen is titrated to 94% or above in a patient who is not SOB or shocked
Omitting ASA when not contraindicated, or giving it before the rapid body survey - protocol sequencing error
criticalPitfallsZh: 未做基线生命体征就给硝酸甘油，或每剂前不复测血压——扣 100%（Protocols）
给硝酸甘油前不筛查 24 小时内万艾可/艾力达或 48 小时内希爱力——未排除禁忌，最高扣 100%
让患者自己走下楼上救护车——心源性胸痛下的用力，患者照护类最高扣 100%
SpO2 96% 时仍上高流量吸氧——不气促、不休克的患者应滴定至 94% 以上即可
无禁忌却不给阿司匹林，或在快速查体之前就给——协议顺序错误
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR gives ASA 160 mg PO and nitroglycerin 0.4 mg SL under the same protocol (no physician order required), plus oxygen titration, rest, and rapid transport. EMR does not establish IV access or give dimenhydrinate. Entonox is available at both levels for the post-3-dose pathway. No Functional Enquiry.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR 同样按本协议给阿司匹林 160 mg 口服和硝酸甘油 0.4 mg 舌下（无需医嘱），并做氧疗滴定、休息与快速转运。EMR 不建立静脉通路、不给茶苯海明。三剂之后的 Entonox 路径两个级别都可用。无功能问诊。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds vascular access with running fluid, dimenhydrinate 1 mg/kg to a maximum of 50 mg for nausea, and the 9-system Functional Enquiry en route. Everything else is identical.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 增加静脉通路并持续输液、恶心时茶苯海明 1 mg/kg（上限 50 mg），以及途中 9 系统功能问诊。其余完全相同。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 62-year-old male, chief complaint of central chest pressure that woke him at 0615, so about 45 minutes of pain now. It is a heavy band-like pressure radiating to the left jaw and left arm, 8 out of 10 at onset, associated with nausea and diaphoresis, not reproducible on palpation, and he had two exertional episodes earlier this week. Initial vitals GCS 15, BP 148/92, pulse 96 regular, resps 22, skin pale cool diaphoretic, SpO2 96% on room air; latest BP 122/78, pulse 88, SpO2 97%, pain now 3 out of 10. History of hypertension and dyslipidemia, ex-smoker, father died of an MI at 58, takes amlodipine and rosuvastatin, no PDE5 inhibitors, no known allergies, last ate at 1900 yesterday. Treatments: kept at rest and carried out, ASA 160 milligrams chewed at 0652, nitroglycerin 0.4 milligrams sublingual at 0658 and 0703 with blood pressure rechecked before each dose, IV established en route.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 62 岁男性，主诉 06:15 被胸骨后压迫感痛醒，至今疼痛约 45 分钟。为沉重箍紧样压迫感，放射至左下颌和左上肢，起病时 8/10，伴恶心和大汗，按压不能复现，本周早些时候另有两次活动后发作。首组生命体征 GCS 15、血压 148/92、脉搏 96 规则、呼吸 22、皮肤苍白发凉大汗、SpO2 室内空气 96%；末组血压 122/78、脉搏 88、SpO2 97%，疼痛降至 3/10。既往高血压、血脂异常，已戒烟，父亲 58 岁死于心梗，服氨氯地平和瑞舒伐他汀，未用 PDE5 抑制剂，无已知过敏，昨晚 19:00 最后进食。处置：全程保持休息并由我们抬出，06:52 阿司匹林 160 mg 嚼服，06:58 和 07:03 各给硝酸甘油 0.4 mg 舌下，每剂前均复测血压，途中已建立静脉通路。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Central chest pressure at rest, radiating to left jaw and arm
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Woke from sleep 0615; heavy band-like pressure 8/10; radiates left jaw/arm; nausea and diaphoresis; two exertional episodes earlier in the week; not reproducible on palpation
pcrKeyPoints.pmhx: Hypertension, dyslipidemia, ex-smoker 30 pack-years, family history of MI
pcrKeyPoints.meds: Amlodipine 5 mg, rosuvastatin 10 mg; no PDE5 inhibitors
treatments: Rest, position of comfort, carried down stairs
O2 titrated to keep SpO2 94% or above (none required at 96%)
ASA 160 mg PO chewed at 0652
Nitroglycerin 0.4 mg SL at 0658 and 0703, BP rechecked before each
RTC transport with cath-lab notification
PCP: IV with running fluid
findings: Levine sign, pale cool diaphoretic
BP 148/92 down to 122/78, pain 8/10 down to 3/10
No JVD, chest clear, no reproducible chest wall pain
SpO2 96-97% throughout

scenarios.titleEn: Hypoglycemia With Decreased LOC - Glucagon and D10W
scenarios.titleZh: 低血糖伴意识下降——胰高血糖素与 D10W
scenarios.dispatchEn: 0730 hrs. Code 3 to an assisted-living apartment in Victoria. 74-year-old female, known insulin-dependent diabetic, found by a care aide unresponsive in her armchair. Hospital is 11 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 07:30，Code 3 前往维多利亚一处协助生活公寓。74 岁女性，已知胰岛素依赖型糖尿病，被护理员发现在扶手椅上无反应。医院车程 11 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: the care aide says she took her morning insulin but refused breakfast. She is breathing but will not wake up.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：护理员称她打了早上的胰岛素但拒绝吃早餐。目前有呼吸但叫不醒。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge; plan glucometer, glucose gel, glucagon (EMR) or D10W (PCP), suction, oxygen, BVM
expected.actionZh: 确认；准备血糖仪、葡萄糖凝胶、胰高血糖素（EMR）或 D10W（PCP）、吸引器、氧气、球囊面罩

expected.actionEn: Anticipate an unresponsive medical patient - airway first, and BGL is mandatory
expected.actionZh: 预判为无反应的内科患者——优先气道，且必须测血糖

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: The care aide lets you into a small warm suite. The patient is slumped in an armchair, head fallen forward onto her chest, snoring loudly. An insulin pen and a used needle are on the side table beside an untouched breakfast tray. No spilled pills, no alcohol. One patient. Warm room, good lighting.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：护理员带你进入一间温暖的小套间。患者瘫坐在扶手椅上，头前倾抵在胸前，鼾声很响。边几上有一支胰岛素笔和一枚用过的针头，旁边是原封未动的早餐托盘。地上无散落药片、无酒瓶。单一患者。房间温暖，照明良好。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (used sharps on the table - important), environment, nature of illness (unresponsive diabetic), one patient
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（桌上有用过的针头，重点）、环境、发病性质（无反应的糖尿病患者）、单一患者

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection; act on the sharps hazard before working around it
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜；在旁边操作前先处理针头危险

expected.actionEn: First look: elderly female slumped forward, snoring respirations, pale and sweaty, untouched breakfast
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：老年女性前倾瘫坐、鼾式呼吸、面色苍白多汗、早餐未动

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: does not respond to voice; withdraws from a trapezius pinch, no eye opening, incomprehensible groaning. EXAMINER (give when assessed): airway - snoring, partially obstructed by the tongue and her chin-on-chest position; opens with a head-tilt chin-lift or jaw thrust and improves markedly when she is laid supine or positioned lateral; respirations 16, adequate depth once the airway is open; radial pulse 104, strong and regular. Skin: pale, cool, very diaphoretic. Modified RBS: no trauma, no medical alert bracelet found initially - one IS present on the left wrist reading 'Insulin Dependent Diabetic'. SpO2 92% RA. C-spine NOT indicated: no trauma, she was seated and did not fall. UNSTABLE: decreased LOC.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：呼唤无反应；斜方肌掐压时有回缩动作，不睁眼，只有含糊呻吟。考官（评估时给出）：气道——鼾声，因舌后坠与下巴抵胸的体位而部分梗阻；仰头抬颏或推举下颌可打开，改为仰卧或侧卧后明显改善；呼吸 16 次/分，气道打开后深度尚可；桡动脉 104 次/分、有力规则。皮肤：苍白、发凉、大汗淋漓。改良快速查体：无外伤，起初未见医疗警示手环——左手腕确有一只，写着「胰岛素依赖型糖尿病」。SpO2 室内空气 92%。无颈椎固定指征：无外伤，患者原本坐着且未跌倒。不稳定：意识下降。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: responds to Pain only - a significantly decreased LOC
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：仅对疼痛有反应——意识显著下降

expected.actionEn: Verbalize c-spine not indicated (no trauma, seated, no fall) - do not immobilize unnecessarily
expected.actionZh: 口述无颈椎固定指征（无外伤、坐位、未跌倒）——不要做不必要的固定

expected.actionEn: Open and maintain the airway with a manual technique; she cannot protect her own airway
expected.actionZh: 用手法开放并维持气道；患者无法自行保护气道

expected.actionEn: Consider a correctly sized airway adjunct and have suction immediately available
expected.actionZh: 考虑尺寸正确的气道辅助装置，并保证吸引器随时可用

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing rate and adequacy once the airway is open
expected.actionZh: 气道打开后评估呼吸频率与是否足够

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation
expected.actionZh: 评估循环

expected.actionEn: Perform a modified rapid body survey; look for a medical alert bracelet, injection sites and any injury
expected.actionZh: 做改良快速查体；查找医疗警示手环、注射部位与任何损伤

expected.actionEn: Note skin: pale cool diaphoretic - classic hypoglycemia
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：苍白、发凉、大汗——典型低血糖表现

expected.actionEn: Apply oxygen to maintain SpO2 at or above 94%
expected.actionZh: 给氧维持 SpO2≥94%

expected.actionEn: Position lateral or three-quarter prone to protect the airway (recovery position for the unconscious medical patient)
expected.actionZh: 置侧卧或 3/4 俯卧位保护气道（无意识内科患者的复原体位）

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Decreased LOC = UNSTABLE, RTC. Correct the hypoglycemia on scene first (the protocol says transport AFTER the first dose of D10W or glucagon), then be ready to load within 15 minutes. Delegate crew members to prep egress as the guideline requires.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。意识下降=不稳定，RTC。先在现场纠正低血糖（协议规定在首剂 D10W 或胰高血糖素后再转运），随后 15 分钟内可装载。按指南要求指派搭档准备撤离路线。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC and act with urgency
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC 并保持紧迫感

expected.actionEn: Correct the hypoglycemia first, then ready to load within 15 minutes
expected.actionZh: 先纠正低血糖，随后 15 分钟内可装载

expected.actionEn: Delegate crew members to prep egress (required by the Diabetic Emergencies guideline)
expected.actionZh: 指派搭档准备撤离路线（糖尿病急症指南要求）

phases.infoEn: PATIENT CANNOT ANSWER - use the CARE AIDE and the medication record: she took her usual 18 units of long-acting insulin at 0700, then said she felt nauseated and refused breakfast; the aide found her unresponsive at 0725. She has had two similar episodes in the past year, both treated by paramedics with sugar. Nothing suggests stroke onset, no seizure witnessed, no fall, no fever. PMHx: type 1 diabetes for 40 years, atrial fibrillation, hypothyroidism, previous hypoglycemic seizures. Meds: insulin glargine 18 units daily, insulin aspart with meals, apixaban, levothyroxine. Allergies: none known. LOI: nothing today; supper at 1800 yesterday.
phases.infoZh: 患者无法回答——需向护理员并查阅用药记录：她 07:00 照常注射了 18 单位长效胰岛素，随后说恶心而拒绝早餐；护理员 07:25 发现她无反应。过去一年有过两次类似发作，都由救护员用糖纠正。无卒中起病提示，未见抽搐，无跌倒，无发热。既往史：1 型糖尿病 40 年、房颤、甲状腺功能减退、既往有低血糖抽搐。用药：甘精胰岛素每日 18 单位、餐时门冬胰岛素、阿哌沙班、左甲状腺素。过敏：无已知。最后进食：今日未进食；昨晚 18:00 晚餐。

expected.actionEn: Establish chief complaint: unresponsiveness in a known diabetic
expected.actionZh: 确立主诉：已知糖尿病患者出现无反应

expected.actionEn: HxC/C from the care aide: insulin taken, dose and time, food missed, time last seen normal, progression, previous similar episodes
expected.actionZh: 向护理员采集现病史：注射的胰岛素及剂量时间、漏餐情况、最后正常时间、进展、既往类似发作

expected.actionEn: PMHx incl duration of diabetes and previous hypoglycemic events
expected.actionZh: 既往史（含糖尿病病程与既往低血糖事件）

expected.actionEn: Medications with doses and schedules from the medication record
expected.actionZh: 查用药记录获取药名、剂量与服用时间

expected.actionEn: Allergies
expected.actionZh: 过敏史

expected.actionEn: LOI - critical here: she missed breakfast after taking insulin
expected.actionZh: 最后进食——本例关键：打完胰岛素后漏了早餐

expected.actionEn: Evaluate for stroke signs and symptoms as the guideline requires in diabetic emergencies
expected.actionZh: 按糖尿病急症指南要求评估卒中症状体征

phases.infoEn: Set 1 - baseline BEFORE treatment: GCS 8 (E1 V2 M5 - no eye opening, incomprehensible sounds, withdraws from pain); BP 142/86; pulse 104 strong irregular (atrial fibrillation); respirations 16 adequate once the airway is open; skin pale cool diaphoretic; pupils equal and reactive, 3 mm; SpO2 92% RA rising to 98% on oxygen; BGL 1.8 mmol/L - MANDATORY in any decreased LOC; temperature 36.6 (reasonable to exclude sepsis). RTC interval 5-6 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组——治疗前基线：GCS 8（E1 V2 M5——不睁眼、发出无法理解的声音、疼痛回缩）；血压 142/86；脉搏 104 有力但不规则（房颤）；呼吸 16，气道打开后深度足够；皮肤苍白发凉大汗；瞳孔等大有反应，3 mm；SpO2 室内空气 92%，吸氧后升至 98%；血糖 1.8 mmol/L——任何意识下降者必测；体温 36.6（用于排除脓毒症，合理）。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟。

expected.actionEn: GCS with components (E1 V2 M5 = 8)
expected.actionZh: GCS 及分项（E1 V2 M5 = 8）

expected.actionEn: BP by auscultation
expected.actionZh: 听诊测血压

expected.actionEn: Pulse - note the irregular rhythm (atrial fibrillation)
expected.actionZh: 脉搏——注意节律不齐（房颤）

expected.actionEn: Respirations rate/depth/character
expected.actionZh: 呼吸频率/深度/性质

expected.actionEn: Skin hands-on
expected.actionZh: 动手查皮肤

expected.actionEn: Pupils - required with any decreased LOC
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔——任何意识下降均须检查

expected.actionEn: SpO2 with calibration
expected.actionZh: SpO2 并校准

expected.actionEn: BGL with correct technique and a clean, uncontaminated sample site - mandatory in decreased LOC
expected.actionZh: 以正确手法在清洁、未污染的部位测血糖——意识下降者必测

expected.actionEn: Temperature - reasonable to screen for infection as a cause of altered LOC
expected.actionZh: 体温——作为意识改变病因筛查感染，合理

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, after treatment when she is alert, en route. ACTOR (now awake and cooperative): general - has had a poor appetite and nausea for two days; CNS - no headache now, no weakness or numbness, no vision change; respiratory - nil; cardiovascular - knows she has an irregular heartbeat; GI/GU - nauseated for two days, no vomiting, no diarrhea, normal urine; integumentary - clammy earlier, now dry; musculoskeletal - nil; endocrine - type 1 diabetes 40 years, admits she sometimes skips meals but still takes full insulin; EENT - nil.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP，治疗后患者清醒时于途中完成。患者演员（已清醒并配合）：整体——近两天食欲差、恶心；中枢神经——现无头痛、无肢体无力麻木、无视觉改变；呼吸——无异常；心血管——知道自己心跳不齐；消化/泌尿——恶心两天、无呕吐腹泻、小便正常；皮肤——之前湿冷、现已干爽；肌肉骨骼——无异常；内分泌——1 型糖尿病 40 年，承认有时漏餐但仍照常打足量胰岛素；眼耳鼻喉——无异常。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health (recent illness, appetite)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——整体健康（近期疾病、食欲）

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS (stroke screen post-recovery)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——中枢神经（恢复后卒中筛查）

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——呼吸

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular (atrial fibrillation)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——心血管（房颤）

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU (nausea and poor intake - the precipitant)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——消化/泌尿（恶心与进食差，本次诱因）

expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——皮肤

expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——肌肉骨骼
