expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——内分泌（重点：胰岛素方案与依从性）

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——眼耳鼻喉

phases.infoEn: Head-to-toe (after she is alert, en route): head/neck - no trauma, no tongue biting, no incontinence noted, no facial droop, speech now clear; chest - clear and equal at all 6 sites, irregularly irregular heart rhythm; abdomen - soft, non-tender; back - no findings; lower extremities - no edema, moves both normally, grip and strength symmetrical; upper extremities - medical alert bracelet on the left wrist, insulin injection sites on the abdomen, no deficit.
phases.infoZh: 从头到脚（患者清醒后于途中完成）：头颈——无外伤、无舌咬伤、未见失禁、无面部下垂、言语已清晰；胸部——6 点听诊清晰对称，心律绝对不齐；腹部——软、无压痛；背部——无异常；下肢——无水肿、双侧活动正常、肌力对称；上肢——左腕有医疗警示手环、腹部有胰岛素注射点、无功能缺损。

expected.actionEn: Head/neck exam incl tongue biting and facial droop (seizure and stroke differentials)
expected.actionZh: 头颈查体（含舌咬伤与面部下垂，用于鉴别抽搐与卒中）

expected.actionEn: Chest exam with 6-site auscultation
expected.actionZh: 胸部查体并 6 点听诊

expected.actionEn: Abdomen exam
expected.actionZh: 腹部查体

expected.actionEn: Back exam
expected.actionZh: 背部查体

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities with motor and sensory comparison
expected.actionZh: 下肢并对比运动与感觉

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities incl the medical alert bracelet and injection sites
expected.actionZh: 上肢（含医疗警示手环与注射部位）

phases.infoEn: Diabetic Emergencies protocol. ALL LEVELS: manage the airway with positioning, suction and adjuncts; oxygen to keep SpO2 at or above 94%; position lateral or three-quarter prone; baseline vitals INCLUDING BGL; evaluate for stroke. Correct hypoglycemia below 4.0 mmol/L: oral glucose gel 15 g ONLY if the patient has sufficient mentation to protect the airway - THIS PATIENT DOES NOT, so oral glucose is CONTRAINDICATED. EMR: give GLUCAGON for insufficient mentation or an unprotected airway - 0.5 to 1 mg IM (or 3 mg IN), repeat after 15 minutes if there is no clinical response; onset 15 minutes. PCP: obtain vascular access and give D10W 10-25 g (100-250 mL of 10% solution) IV; use glucagon only if IV access cannot be obtained. Transport after the first dose. Recheck BGL after treatment.
phases.infoZh: 糖尿病急症协议。各级别通用：以体位、吸引和辅助装置管理气道；给氧维持 SpO2≥94%；置侧卧或 3/4 俯卧位；完成含血糖在内的基线生命体征；评估卒中。纠正血糖低于 4.0 mmol/L：仅当患者神志足以保护气道时才口服葡萄糖凝胶 15 g——本例患者做不到，故口服葡萄糖属禁忌。EMR：对神志不足或气道无保护者给胰高血糖素——0.5-1 mg 肌注（或 3 mg 鼻内），15 分钟无临床反应可重复；起效 15 分钟。PCP：建立静脉通路并给 D10W 10-25 g（10% 溶液 100-250 mL）静脉推注；仅在无法建立静脉通路时才用胰高血糖素。首剂后即转运。治疗后复测血糖。

expected.actionEn: Initiate the Diabetic Emergencies protocol on correct indications with a BGL below 4.0 confirmed and baseline vitals done
expected.actionZh: 在血糖低于 4.0 已确认、基线生命体征完成的前提下按正确指征启动糖尿病急症协议

expected.actionEn: Recognize oral glucose is CONTRAINDICATED with insufficient mentation and an unprotected airway
expected.actionZh: 识别神志不足、气道无保护时口服葡萄糖为禁忌

expected.actionEn: EMR: glucagon 0.5-1 mg IM with 6 rights, correct IM site and needle; PCP: D10W 10-25 g IV, glucagon only if IV access fails
expected.actionZh: EMR：胰高血糖素 0.5-1 mg 肌注，六项核对、部位与针具正确；PCP：D10W 10-25 g 静脉给药，仅在静脉失败时用胰高血糖素

expected.actionEn: Airway management skill: correct positioning, suction if needed, properly sized adjunct
expected.actionZh: 气道管理技能：体位正确、按需吸引、辅助装置尺寸合适

expected.actionEn: Recheck the BGL after treatment and document the response
expected.actionZh: 治疗后复测血糖并记录反应

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs and LOC continuously - a change in GCS requires a full ABC reassessment. Set 2 (about 6 minutes after treatment, en route): GCS 15 (E4V5M6) - awake, oriented, embarrassed and asking to stay home; BP 138/82; pulse 92 irregular; respirations 14; skin pink warm dry; pupils equal reactive; SpO2 98% on oxygen; BGL 7.4. EXAMINER: she now says she feels fine and wants to refuse transport - the candidate should encourage transport, explain the long-acting insulin risk of recurrent hypoglycemia, feed her a complex carbohydrate if her airway is now protected, and involve the care aide.
phases.infoZh: 持续复评 ABC 与意识——GCS 变化后必须完整复评 ABC。第 2 组（治疗后约 6 分钟，途中）：GCS 15（E4V5M6）——清醒、定向力正常、觉得不好意思并要求留在家里；血压 138/82；脉搏 92 不规则；呼吸 14；皮肤红润温干；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 吸氧下 98%；血糖 7.4。考官提示：她此时称自己没事、想拒绝转运——考生应劝导转运，说明长效胰岛素会导致低血糖复发的风险，在气道已能自我保护时给她吃复合碳水，并让护理员参与沟通。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and interventions after treatment and after every change in LOC
expected.actionZh: 治疗后及每次意识变化后复评 ABC 与各项处置

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 5-6 minutes including a repeat BGL
expected.actionZh: 5-6 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征，含复测血糖

expected.actionEn: Once she can protect her airway, give complex carbohydrate and explain the risk of recurrent hypoglycemia from long-acting insulin
expected.actionZh: 在她能保护气道后给予复合碳水，并解释长效胰岛素导致低血糖复发的风险

expected.actionEn: Manage the refusal professionally: strongly recommend transport, involve the care aide, do not simply accept the refusal
expected.actionZh: 专业处理拒绝转运：强烈建议转运、让护理员参与，不可简单接受拒绝

phases.infoEn: Notify the receiving facility. Hand-off must include both BGL values, the drug given with time and route, and the response. PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 通知接收医院。交接必须包含两次血糖值、所给药物的时间与途径以及治疗反应。5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: Notify the receiving facility with the BGL and treatment
expected.actionZh: 向接收医院预报血糖值与处置

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off with initial and final GCS, both BGLs, drug time/dose/route and response
expected.actionZh: 完整交接：首末 GCS、两次血糖、给药时间/剂量/途径及反应

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确 PCR

vitalsSets.timeHint: approx 6 min after glucagon/D10W, en route

criticalPitfallsEn: Not obtaining a blood glucose level in a patient with decreased LOC - failure to obtain a diagnostic when clearly indicated, and it makes the protocol decision unjustifiable
Giving oral glucose gel to a patient who cannot protect her airway - non-indicated skill with aspiration risk, up to 100%
Leaving an unresponsive patient supine and unprotected without airway management or recovery positioning - 100% (Airway/Position)
Immobilizing the spine when there is no trauma - non-indicated intervention causing delay
Accepting a refusal of transport after correcting hypoglycemia caused by long-acting insulin without explaining the recurrence risk - overall patient care deduction
criticalPitfallsZh: 意识下降患者不测血糖——明确有指征却不做的检查，且使协议决策失去依据
给无法保护气道的患者口服葡萄糖凝胶——非指征操作且有误吸风险，最高扣 100%
让无反应患者仰卧且不做气道管理或复原体位——扣 100%（气道/体位）
无外伤却做脊柱固定——非指征操作并造成延误
纠正长效胰岛素所致低血糖后不解释复发风险就接受拒绝转运——患者照护类扣分
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR treats insufficient mentation with GLUCAGON 0.5-1 mg IM (or 3 mg IN, repeat after 15 minutes if no response). Oral glucose 15 g is EMR scope but only for patients with sufficient mentation to protect the airway - not this patient initially. EMR does not establish IV access or give D10W. No Functional Enquiry.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR 对神志不足者用胰高血糖素 0.5-1 mg 肌注（或 3 mg 鼻内，15 分钟无反应可重复）。口服葡萄糖 15 g 属 EMR 范围，但只能用于神志足以保护气道者——本例初始不适用。EMR 不建立静脉通路、不给 D10W。无功能问诊。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP obtains vascular access and gives D10W 10-25 g (100-250 mL of 10% solution) IV as first-line, reserving glucagon for failed IV access. PCP also performs the 9-system Functional Enquiry once she is alert. Watch for extravasation - D10W causes tissue necrosis.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 首选建立静脉通路并给 D10W 10-25 g（10% 溶液 100-250 mL）静脉给药，仅在静脉通路失败时才用胰高血糖素。患者清醒后 PCP 还需完成 9 系统功能问诊。注意防止药液外渗——D10W 外渗会引起组织坏死。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 74-year-old female, a 40-year type 1 diabetic, found unresponsive in her armchair at 0725 by her care aide after taking her usual 18 units of long-acting insulin at 0700 and then refusing breakfast because of nausea. On arrival she was responsive to pain only, GCS 8, with snoring respirations, BP 142/86, pulse 104 irregular, resps 16, skin pale cool and diaphoretic, SpO2 92% on room air, and a blood glucose of 1.8. She is now GCS 15 and fully oriented with a blood glucose of 7.4, BP 138/82, pulse 92 irregular, SpO2 98%. History of type 1 diabetes, atrial fibrillation, hypothyroidism and previous hypoglycemic seizures; medications are insulin glargine and aspart, apixaban and levothyroxine; no known allergies; nothing to eat since supper yesterday. Treatments: airway opened and maintained with lateral positioning, oxygen to keep saturations above 94 percent, and D10W 25 grams IV at 0741 with the glucose rechecked afterwards. She is at risk of recurrent hypoglycemia because the long-acting insulin is still on board.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 74 岁女性，1 型糖尿病 40 年，07:00 照常注射 18 单位长效胰岛素后因恶心拒绝早餐，07:25 被护理员发现在扶手椅上无反应。我们到场时仅对疼痛有反应，GCS 8，鼾式呼吸，血压 142/86、脉搏 104 不规则、呼吸 16、皮肤苍白发凉大汗、SpO2 室内空气 92%，血糖 1.8。目前 GCS 15、定向力完全恢复，血糖 7.4、血压 138/82、脉搏 92 不规则、SpO2 98%。既往 1 型糖尿病、房颤、甲减及既往低血糖抽搐；用药为甘精与门冬胰岛素、阿哌沙班、左甲状腺素；无已知过敏；自昨晚晚餐后未进食。处置：开放并以侧卧位维持气道、给氧维持血氧高于 94%、07:41 给 D10W 25 g 静脉推注并于其后复测血糖。因长效胰岛素仍在体内，她有低血糖复发风险。

pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Took 18 units long-acting insulin at 0700, refused breakfast due to nausea, found unresponsive 0725; two similar episodes in the past year
pcrKeyPoints.pmhx: Type 1 diabetes 40 years, atrial fibrillation, hypothyroidism, previous hypoglycemic seizures
pcrKeyPoints.meds: Insulin glargine 18 units daily, insulin aspart with meals, apixaban, levothyroxine
treatments: Airway opened, lateral/recovery positioning, suction available
O2 titrated to SpO2 94% or above
Oral glucose withheld - insufficient mentation
PCP: IV access and D10W 25 g IV at 0741 (EMR: glucagon 1 mg IM)
BGL rechecked after treatment; complex carbohydrate given once airway protected
findings: GCS 8 (E1V2M5) improving to 15 (E4V5M6)
BGL 1.8 rising to 7.4 mmol/L
Pale cool diaphoretic skin resolving
Irregular pulse consistent with known atrial fibrillation
No stroke signs, no trauma, no seizure witnessed

scenarios.titleEn: Suspected Opioid Overdose - Ventilate First, Then Naloxone
scenarios.titleZh: 疑似阿片类药物过量——先通气，再用纳洛酮
scenarios.dispatchEn: 0210 hrs. Code 3 to a single-room-occupancy hotel in Vancouver's Downtown Eastside. 31-year-old male found unresponsive in a hallway by building staff. Police are en route but not yet on scene. Hospital is 7 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 02:10，Code 3 前往温哥华市中心东区一处单间旅馆。31 岁男性被楼内工作人员发现在走廊无反应。警察正在赶来但尚未到场。医院车程 7 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: staff report he is 'barely breathing' and blue around the lips. A bystander says he used 'down' about 20 minutes ago.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：工作人员称他「几乎没呼吸」、口唇发绀。一名旁观者说他约 20 分钟前用过「down」（芬太尼类毒品）。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge; plan BVM with oxygen, suction, OPA/NPA, naloxone, glucometer
expected.actionZh: 确认；准备接氧的球囊面罩、吸引器、口咽/鼻咽通气道、纳洛酮、血糖仪

expected.actionEn: Anticipate respiratory failure - ventilation is the priority, not the drug
expected.actionZh: 预判呼吸衰竭——首要处置是通气而不是给药

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Dim, narrow hallway with worn carpet. Building staff hold the door. Beside the patient is a used syringe with the needle exposed and a piece of foil - a genuine sharps hazard the candidate must manage or verbalize before kneeling. Two other residents are watching from a doorway; they are not aggressive. The patient lies on his back, cyanotic around the lips, chest barely moving. One patient. Room temperature about 20 degrees C.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：昏暗狭窄的走廊，地毯破旧。楼管人员帮忙扶着门。患者身旁有一支针头外露的用过注射器和一片锡箔——这是真实的锐器危险，考生跪下前必须处理或口述。两名住客在门口张望，无攻击性。患者仰卧，口唇发绀，胸廓几乎不动。单一患者。室温约 20 摄氏度。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards - exposed needle and drug paraphernalia, dim confined hallway, bystanders, police not yet on scene
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源——外露针头与吸毒用具、昏暗狭窄走廊、旁观者、警察尚未到场

expected.actionEn: ACT on the sharps hazard: move or safely dispose of the needle before working over the patient
expected.actionZh: 对锐器危险采取行动：在患者上方操作前先移开或安全处置针头

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection (splash and airway secretions)
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜（有喷溅与气道分泌物风险）

expected.actionEn: First look: cyanotic lips, minimal chest movement, drug paraphernalia beside him
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：口唇发绀、胸廓活动极小、身旁有吸毒用具

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: unresponsive - no response to voice, no response to a trapezius pinch. EXAMINER (give when assessed): airway - snoring with vomit residue at the corner of the mouth requiring SUCTION, then an OPA is tolerated (no gag reflex); respirations 4 per minute, shallow and ineffective - VENTILATIONS MUST BE ASSISTED IMMEDIATELY with a BVM connected to oxygen at 8-10 breaths per minute, confirming chest rise; carotid pulse 116, weak (radial pulse is absent). Skin: cyanotic centrally, pale and cool peripherally. Modified RBS: no trauma, no medical alert; PINPOINT PUPILS; a fresh injection site in the left antecubital fossa. SpO2 initially 72 percent, rising with ventilation. UNSTABLE: respiratory failure with unresponsiveness.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：无反应——呼唤无反应，斜方肌掐压也无反应。考官（评估时给出）：气道——鼾声，口角有呕吐残留，需吸引，随后可耐受口咽通气道（无咽反射）；呼吸 4 次/分、浅而无效——必须立即用接氧的球囊面罩以 8-10 次/分辅助通气并确认胸廓起伏；颈动脉搏动 116 次/分、细弱（桡动脉摸不到）。皮肤：中心性发绀，四肢苍白发凉。改良快速查体：无外伤、无医疗警示标识；瞳孔针尖样；左肘窝有新鲜注射痕迹。SpO2 初始 72%，通气后回升。不稳定：呼吸衰竭伴无反应。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: Unresponsive - this patient cannot protect his own airway
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：Unresponsive——该患者无法保护自身气道

expected.actionEn: Verbalize c-spine not indicated (no trauma found, no fall witnessed) after a deliberate check
expected.actionZh: 经有意识的检查后口述无颈椎固定指征（未见外伤、无目击跌倒）

expected.actionEn: Open the airway, SUCTION the vomit (10-15 seconds in an adult) and insert a correctly sized OPA
expected.actionZh: 开放气道、吸引呕吐物（成人 10-15 秒）并置入尺寸正确的口咽通气道

expected.actionEn: Recognize inadequate respirations and BEGIN ASSISTED VENTILATIONS IMMEDIATELY - this is the single most important action of the station
expected.actionZh: 识别呼吸不足并立即开始辅助通气——这是本站最关键的动作

expected.actionEn: Use the C-A-B approach for the unconscious patient and check the carotid pulse
expected.actionZh: 对无意识患者采用 C-A-B 顺序并触摸颈动脉搏动

expected.actionEn: Modified rapid body survey: look for trauma, injection sites, patches and paraphernalia
expected.actionZh: 改良快速查体：查找外伤、注射痕迹、药物贴剂与吸毒用具

expected.actionEn: Note skin: central cyanosis, cool and pale peripherally
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：中心性发绀、四肢苍白发凉

expected.actionEn: Deliver oxygen via the BVM to bring SpO2 to 94 percent or above
expected.actionZh: 经球囊面罩给氧，使 SpO2 升至 94% 以上

expected.actionEn: Position supine for ventilation; do NOT place a patient requiring assisted respirations in the recovery position
expected.actionZh: 为通气置仰卧位；需要辅助呼吸的患者不得置于复原体位

expected.actionEn: Use two-person BVM technique with the partner, confirming an effective seal and chest rise
expected.actionZh: 与搭档采用双人球囊面罩技术，确认密封良好且胸廓有起伏

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Unresponsive with respiratory failure = UNSTABLE, RTC. Ventilate, give naloxone, and transport - the protocol says transport and continue assessment, treatment and protocol en route. Ready to load within 15 minutes. Note: a patient who wakes up does NOT become non-RTC; naloxone is shorter-acting than most opioids and he can re-sedate.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。无反应伴呼吸衰竭=不稳定，RTC。先通气、给纳洛酮，然后转运——协议规定转运并在途中继续评估、治疗与执行协议。15 分钟内可装载。注意：患者醒来并不等于变成非 RTC；纳洛酮作用时间短于多数阿片类，患者可能再次昏睡。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC and act with urgency
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC 并保持紧迫感

expected.actionEn: Ready to load within 15 minutes with ventilations maintained throughout the move
expected.actionZh: 15 分钟内可装载，并在搬运全程维持通气

expected.actionEn: Maintain RTC status even if he wakes - verbalize the risk of re-sedation as naloxone wears off
expected.actionZh: 即使患者清醒也维持 RTC——口述纳洛酮失效后再次昏睡的风险

phases.infoEn: PATIENT CANNOT ANSWER INITIALLY - use BYSTANDERS AND STAFF: he was seen smoking off foil and then injecting about 20 minutes ago; he was found down roughly 5 minutes before the 911 call. Substance believed to be fentanyl-contaminated 'down'. No trauma witnessed, no seizure witnessed. AFTER NALOXONE the patient can answer: he used alone in the hallway, has used daily for 3 years, has been revived twice before, took no other drugs tonight but drank 3 beers. PMHx: hepatitis C, previous overdoses, asthma as a child. Meds: none prescribed; not on opioid agonist therapy. Allergies: none known. LOI: alcohol tonight, food yesterday afternoon.
phases.infoZh: 患者初期无法回答——需向旁观者和楼管采集：有人看到他约 20 分钟前先用锡箔吸食、随后注射；他在呼叫 911 前约 5 分钟被发现倒地。所用物质据信是掺芬太尼的「down」。未见外伤，未见抽搐。用纳洛酮后患者可回答：他独自在走廊使用，已连续 3 年每天使用，此前被抢救过两次，今晚未用其他毒品但喝了 3 瓶啤酒。既往史：丙型肝炎、既往多次过量、儿时哮喘。用药：无处方药；未接受阿片类替代治疗。过敏：无已知。最后进食：今晚饮酒，昨天下午吃过东西。

expected.actionEn: Establish chief complaint: unresponsiveness with respiratory depression, suspected opioid overdose
expected.actionZh: 确立主诉：无反应伴呼吸抑制，疑似阿片类过量

expected.actionEn: HxC/C from bystanders: substance, route, time of use, time found down, co-ingestants, previous overdoses
expected.actionZh: 向旁观者采集现病史：所用物质、途径、使用时间、被发现时间、合并使用物质、既往过量史

expected.actionEn: PMHx (hepatitis C, previous overdoses, asthma)
expected.actionZh: 既往史（丙肝、既往过量、哮喘）

expected.actionEn: Medications incl opioid agonist therapy status
expected.actionZh: 用药史（含是否在用阿片类替代治疗）

expected.actionEn: Allergies
expected.actionZh: 过敏史

expected.actionEn: LOI incl alcohol
expected.actionZh: 最后进食（含饮酒）

phases.infoEn: Set 1 - baseline with ventilations in progress: GCS 3 (E1 V1 M1); BP 96/58; carotid pulse 116 weak, radial absent; respirations 4 spontaneous, now assisted at 10 per minute; skin cyanotic centrally, cool and pale peripherally; PUPILS PINPOINT and equal - a key opioid finding; SpO2 72 percent rising to 96 percent with ventilation; BGL 5.9 - MANDATORY, the protocol requires a blood glucose and correction if it is 4 mmol/L or less; temperature 35.8 (opioid overdose causes hypothermia and he was on a cold floor).
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组——在辅助通气进行中的基线：GCS 3（E1 V1 M1）；血压 96/58；颈动脉 116 细弱，桡动脉摸不到；自主呼吸 4 次/分，现以 10 次/分辅助；皮肤中心性发绀、四肢苍白发凉；瞳孔针尖样且等大——阿片类的关键体征；SpO2 由 72% 经通气升至 96%；血糖 5.9——必测，协议要求测血糖，若≤4 mmol/L 须纠正；体温 35.8（阿片类过量可致低体温，且他躺在冰冷地面）。

expected.actionEn: GCS with components (E1 V1 M1 = 3)
expected.actionZh: GCS 及分项（E1 V1 M1 = 3）

expected.actionEn: BP by auscultation
expected.actionZh: 听诊测血压

expected.actionEn: Pulse - assess the carotid when the radial is absent, and state rate, strength and rhythm
expected.actionZh: 脉搏——桡动脉不可及时评估颈动脉，并报告频率、强度与节律

expected.actionEn: Respirations - rate, depth and effectiveness both spontaneous and assisted
expected.actionZh: 呼吸——自主与辅助状态下的频率、深度与有效性

expected.actionEn: Skin hands-on
expected.actionZh: 动手查皮肤

expected.actionEn: Pupils - identify pinpoint pupils as an opioid sign
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔——识别针尖样瞳孔为阿片类体征

expected.actionEn: SpO2 with calibration; document the improvement with ventilation
expected.actionZh: SpO2 并校准；记录通气后的改善

expected.actionEn: BGL - explicitly required by the Narcotic Overdose protocol
expected.actionZh: 血糖——阿片类过量协议明确要求

expected.actionEn: Temperature - hypothermia is a listed feature of opioid overdose
expected.actionZh: 体温——低体温是阿片类过量的已列表现

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, after naloxone when he can answer, en route. EXAMINER NOTE: no deduction for systems he cannot answer while unresponsive. ACTOR (awake, irritable): general - lost weight, sleeping rough some nights; CNS - headache now, no seizure, no weakness; respiratory - feels short of breath and 'sick' since waking (early withdrawal); cardiovascular - heart racing; GI/GU - nauseated and wants to vomit (withdrawal - suction ready); integumentary - old track marks, fresh site left antecubital; musculoskeletal - aching all over (withdrawal); endocrine - nil; EENT - nil.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP，用纳洛酮后患者能回答时于途中完成。考官提示：患者无反应期间无法回答的系统不扣分。患者演员（清醒、易激惹）：整体——体重下降、有时露宿；中枢神经——现有头痛、无抽搐、无肢体无力；呼吸——醒来后觉得气短、难受（早期戒断）；心血管——心跳快；消化/泌尿——恶心想吐（戒断表现——备好吸引）；皮肤——陈旧针痕，左肘窝新鲜注射点；肌肉骨骼——全身酸痛（戒断）；内分泌——无异常；眼耳鼻喉——无异常。

expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——整体健康

expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——中枢神经

expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——呼吸（与主诉相关）

expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——消化/泌尿（纳洛酮后呕吐风险）

expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——眼耳鼻喉

phases.infoEn: Head-to-toe: head/neck - no trauma, no tongue biting, vomit residue cleared, no neck stiffness; chest - clear and equal at all 6 sites once ventilated, no crackles; abdomen - soft, non-tender; back - no injury (checked with a careful roll while ventilating); lower extremities - track marks, no injury, no needle in situ; upper extremities - fresh injection site left antecubital fossa, old track marks bilaterally, CSM intact.
phases.infoZh: 从头到脚：头颈——无外伤、无舌咬伤、呕吐残留已清除、颈部无强直；胸部——通气后 6 点听诊清晰对称、无湿啰音；腹部——软、无压痛；背部——无损伤（通气状态下小心翻身检查）；下肢——有陈旧针痕、无损伤、无留置针头；上肢——左肘窝新鲜注射点、双侧陈旧针痕、远端 CSM 完好。

expected.actionEn: Head/neck exam incl airway clearance and trauma screen
expected.actionZh: 头颈查体（含气道清理与外伤筛查）

expected.actionEn: Chest exam with 6-site auscultation - screen for aspiration and pulmonary edema
expected.actionZh: 胸部查体并 6 点听诊——筛查误吸与肺水肿

expected.actionEn: Abdomen exam
expected.actionZh: 腹部查体

expected.actionEn: Back exam
expected.actionZh: 背部查体

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities - check for concealed needles before palpating
expected.actionZh: 下肢——触诊前先检查有无藏匿针头

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities - injection sites and CSM
expected.actionZh: 上肢——注射部位与远端 CSM

phases.infoEn: Suspected Narcotic Overdose protocol. ALL LEVELS: manage the airway with positioning, suctioning and adjuncts; SUPPORT VENTILATIONS - consider two-person BVM technique; oxygen to keep SpO2 at 94 percent or above; obtain history and baseline vitals INCLUDING BGL; if BGL is 4 mmol/L or less, correct it; then administer NALOXONE 0.4 mg IM or IV. Repeat 0.4 mg after 3 minutes if SpO2 of 94 percent or above and a ventilation rate above 10 have not been achieved; then 0.8 mg after a further 3 minutes; then 2.0 mg after a further 3 minutes. Intranasal dose is 4 mg. Transport and continue the protocol en route. PCP ADDITION: in continued unconsciousness and apnea, establish vascular access and give naloxone intravenously. THE TARGET IS ADEQUATE VENTILATION, NOT FULL AWAKENING - titrate to a respiratory rate above 10 and SpO2 at or above 94 percent, avoiding acute withdrawal and combativeness.
phases.infoZh: 疑似阿片类过量协议。各级别通用：以体位、吸引和辅助装置管理气道；支持通气——可考虑双人球囊面罩技术；给氧维持 SpO2≥94%；采集病史与含血糖的基线生命体征；血糖≤4 mmol/L 时先纠正；然后给纳洛酮 0.4 mg 肌注或静注。若 3 分钟后仍未达到 SpO2≥94% 且通气频率>10，追加 0.4 mg；再过 3 分钟追加 0.8 mg；再过 3 分钟追加 2.0 mg。鼻内给药剂量为 4 mg。转运并在途中继续执行协议。PCP 追加：持续昏迷且呼吸停止时建立静脉通路并静脉给纳洛酮。治疗目标是足够的通气，而不是完全清醒——滴定至呼吸频率>10 且 SpO2≥94% 即可，避免诱发急性戒断和躁动。

expected.actionEn: Assist ventilations BEFORE giving naloxone - ventilation is the life-saving intervention
expected.actionZh: 在给纳洛酮之前先辅助通气——通气才是救命措施

expected.actionEn: Obtain a BGL before or alongside naloxone as the protocol requires, and correct it if 4 mmol/L or less
expected.actionZh: 按协议要求在给纳洛酮前或同时测血糖，≤4 mmol/L 时予以纠正

expected.actionEn: Naloxone 0.4 mg IM/IV with the 6 rights, correct site and needle
expected.actionZh: 纳洛酮 0.4 mg 肌注/静注，六项核对、部位与针具正确

expected.actionEn: Verbalize the escalation schedule: repeat at 3-minute intervals 0.4, 0.8 then 2.0 mg if SpO2 94 percent or above and rate above 10 are not achieved
expected.actionZh: 口述升级给药方案：每 3 分钟重复，依次 0.4、0.8、2.0 mg，直至 SpO2≥94% 且频率>10

expected.actionEn: Airway skill: suction correctly, size and insert the OPA properly, keep suction at hand for post-naloxone vomiting
expected.actionZh: 气道技能：正确吸引、口咽通气道尺寸与置入正确、纳洛酮后呕吐时吸引器随手可及

expected.actionEn: Ventilation skill: BVM connected to oxygen, good seal, 8-10 breaths per minute, chest rise confirmed, no hyperventilation
expected.actionZh: 通气技能：球囊面罩接氧、密封良好、8-10 次/分、确认胸廓起伏、不过度通气

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs continuously; a change in LOC demands a full ABC reassessment. Set 2 (4 minutes after the first naloxone dose, en route): GCS 13 (E3 V4 M6) - eyes open to voice, confused and irritable, trying to pull off the mask; BP 118/70; pulse 104 regular, radial now palpable; respirations 16 spontaneous and adequate; skin pink, warm, dry; pupils 3 mm and reactive (no longer pinpoint); SpO2 97 percent on oxygen; BGL 5.9. He is vomiting - suction and positioning are needed. EXAMINER: if the candidate gave too much naloxone too fast, he becomes combative and refuses care; the candidate must de-escalate calmly, keep him monitored and continue transport.
phases.infoZh: 持续复评 ABC；意识变化必须完整复评 ABC。第 2 组（首剂纳洛酮后 4 分钟，途中）：GCS 13（E3 V4 M6）——呼唤睁眼、意识错乱易激惹、试图扯掉面罩；血压 118/70；脉搏 104 规则，桡动脉已可触及；自主呼吸 16 次/分且足够；皮肤红润温干；瞳孔 3 mm 有反应（不再是针尖样）；SpO2 吸氧下 97%；血糖 5.9。患者出现呕吐——需要吸引和体位处理。考官提示：若考生给药过多过快，患者将变得躁动并拒绝救治；考生必须冷静安抚、持续监护并继续转运。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and interventions after naloxone and after every change in LOC
expected.actionZh: 给纳洛酮后及每次意识变化后复评 ABC 与各项处置

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 5-6 minutes, including a repeat pupil check
expected.actionZh: 5-6 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征，含复查瞳孔

expected.actionEn: Manage post-naloxone vomiting: suction and airway positioning immediately
expected.actionZh: 处理纳洛酮后呕吐：立即吸引并调整气道体位

expected.actionEn: De-escalate agitation professionally and keep the patient monitored; maintain RTC status because of the re-sedation risk
expected.actionZh: 专业地安抚躁动并持续监护；因再次昏睡风险维持 RTC 状态

phases.infoEn: Critical patient - notify the receiving facility. The hand-off must state the naloxone dose, route and time, the ventilation support given, and the risk of re-sedation. PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 危重患者——通知接收医院。交接必须说明纳洛酮的剂量、途径与时间、所给的通气支持，以及再次昏睡的风险。5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: En-route notification stating that the apneic patient was ventilated
expected.actionZh: 途中预报并说明已对呼吸抑制患者实施通气

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off with naloxone dose/route/time, ventilation support and re-sedation risk
expected.actionZh: 完整交接：纳洛酮剂量/途径/时间、通气支持及再昏睡风险

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确 PCR

vitalsSets.timeHint: 4 min after naloxone 0.4 mg, en route

criticalPitfallsEn: Giving naloxone before assisting ventilations - the patient is hypoxic and ventilation is the priority; failing to intervene immediately on absent or inadequate respirations is 100%
Not obtaining a blood glucose - explicitly required by the Narcotic Overdose protocol before naloxone
Deciding on naloxone from LOC alone without adequate assessment - explicitly listed as a 25% protocol deduction
Placing a patient who requires assisted ventilations in the recovery position - position deduction plus airway risk
Kneeling or working over the exposed needle without dealing with it - identifying a hazard and failing to act is a 5% scene deduction and a real safety failure
Letting an awakened patient refuse transport without recognizing the re-sedation risk of naloxone
criticalPitfallsZh: 先给纳洛酮而不先辅助通气——患者处于缺氧状态，通气才是首要；对呼吸消失或不足不立即处置扣 100%
不测血糖——阿片类过量协议明确要求在给纳洛酮前完成
仅凭意识水平就决定用纳洛酮而不做充分评估——评分手册明列扣 25%
把需要辅助通气的患者置于复原体位——体位扣分并带来气道风险
不处理外露针头就跪在旁边操作——发现危险却不采取行动属现场类扣 5%，也是真实的安全失误
患者清醒后让其拒绝转运，却未认识到纳洛酮失效后会再次昏睡
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR gives naloxone 0.4 mg IM (or 4 mg IN) on the same escalation schedule, with ventilation, suction, OPA/NPA and oxygen. EMR does not establish IV access, so persistent apnea is managed with continued BVM ventilation, repeat IM doses and rapid transport. No Functional Enquiry.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR 按同样的升级方案给纳洛酮 0.4 mg 肌注（或 4 mg 鼻内），并配合通气、吸引、口咽/鼻咽通气道和吸氧。EMR 不建立静脉通路，因此持续呼吸停止时以继续球囊面罩通气、重复肌注和快速转运处理。无功能问诊。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP may establish vascular access and give naloxone intravenously in continued unconsciousness and apnea, which has a 1-minute onset versus 3 minutes IM. PCP also completes the Functional Enquiry once the patient can answer. The titration target is unchanged: adequate ventilation, not full arousal.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 在患者持续昏迷且呼吸停止时可建立静脉通路并静脉给纳洛酮，起效 1 分钟（肌注为 3 分钟）。患者能回答后 PCP 还需完成功能问诊。滴定目标不变：达到足够通气即可，而非完全唤醒。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 31-year-old male found unresponsive in an SRO hallway at approximately 0205 after witnesses saw him smoke and then inject what is believed to be fentanyl-contaminated down about 20 minutes before. On our arrival he was GCS 3, cyanotic, with respirations of 4 and ineffective, no radial pulse, carotid 116 and weak, pinpoint pupils, SpO2 72 percent, blood glucose 5.9 and temperature 35.8. We suctioned vomit, inserted an oropharyngeal airway and began two-person bag-valve-mask ventilations with oxygen at 10 per minute, which brought his saturations to 96 percent, then gave naloxone 0.4 milligrams IM at 0219. Four minutes later he is GCS 13, breathing 16 spontaneously and adequately, BP 118/70, pulse 104 with a palpable radial, pupils 3 millimetres and reactive, SpO2 97 percent. He has vomited once since waking and we have kept suction at hand. History of hepatitis C and previous overdoses, not on opioid agonist therapy, no known allergies, three beers tonight. He remains a rapid transport because the naloxone will wear off before the opioid does.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 31 岁男性，约 02:05 被发现在单间旅馆走廊无反应；目击者称他约 20 分钟前先吸食后注射，所用物质据信为掺芬太尼的「down」。我们到场时 GCS 3、发绀、呼吸 4 次/分且无效、桡动脉摸不到、颈动脉 116 细弱、瞳孔针尖样、SpO2 72%、血糖 5.9、体温 35.8。我们吸引了呕吐物、置入口咽通气道，并以双人球囊面罩接氧按 10 次/分开始通气，血氧升至 96%，随后于 02:19 肌注纳洛酮 0.4 mg。4 分钟后 GCS 13，自主呼吸 16 次/分且足够，血压 118/70，脉搏 104 且桡动脉可触及，瞳孔 3 mm 有反应，SpO2 97%。醒来后呕吐过一次，我们已随手备好吸引。既往丙型肝炎和多次过量史，未接受阿片类替代治疗，无已知过敏，今晚饮啤酒 3 瓶。因纳洛酮会先于阿片类失效，他仍按快速转运处理。

scenarios.dispatchEn: 0815 hrs. Code 3 to a ground-floor apartment in Nanaimo. 71-year-old female with known COPD, increasing shortness of breath over three days, now unable to speak in full sentences. Her daughter called. Hospital is 10 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 08:15，Code 3 前往纳奈莫一处一楼公寓。71 岁女性，已知慢阻肺，气促加重 3 天，现已无法说完整句子。由其女儿报警。医院车程 10 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: she has home oxygen and has used her blue inhaler many times this morning without relief.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：她家中有制氧设备，今早已多次使用蓝色吸入器但无缓解。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge; plan nebulizer with salbutamol and ipratropium, oxygen, BVM with PEEP, CPAP (PCP), and a stretcher to the door
expected.actionZh: 确认；准备沙丁胺醇与异丙托溴铵雾化、氧气、带 PEEP 阀的球囊面罩、CPAP（PCP），并把担架床推到门口

expected.actionEn: Anticipate that this patient must not be walked - bring equipment and the stretcher to her
expected.actionZh: 预判该患者不能行走——把装备和担架床带到她身边

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: Small overheated apartment, a home oxygen concentrator running in the corner with tubing across the floor - a trip hazard and an oxygen-safety consideration. No smoking materials lit. The patient sits bolt upright on a kitchen chair, leaning forward on her elbows in a tripod position, pursed-lip breathing. Her daughter is anxious and talking over her. One patient. Room about 26 degrees C.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：狭小闷热的公寓，角落里一台家用制氧机在运转，管路横过地面——既是绊倒风险也涉及氧气安全。现场无点燃的吸烟物品。患者笔直坐在餐椅上，双肘撑在膝上呈三脚架体位，缩唇呼吸。女儿情绪焦虑、不断插话。单一患者。室温约 26 摄氏度。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (oxygen tubing trip hazard, oxygen safety, overheated room), environment, nature of illness (respiratory distress), one patient
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（氧管绊倒风险、氧气安全、房间过热）、环境、发病性质（呼吸窘迫）、单一患者

expected.actionEn: Don gloves, eye protection, and verbalize a mask given an infectious respiratory presentation
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜，并因呼吸道感染表现口述佩戴口罩

expected.actionEn: First look: tripod position, pursed-lip breathing, accessory muscle use, one-to-two-word sentences
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：三脚架体位、缩唇呼吸、动用辅助呼吸肌、只能说一两个词

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: alert but exhausted, speaks 1-2 words at a time, will not lie down. EXAMINER (give when assessed): airway clear and self-maintained; respirations 32, laboured with marked accessory muscle use, prolonged expiration, audible wheeze; radial pulse 118, regular. Skin: pale with dusky lips, warm and moist. Modified RBS: barrel chest, no trauma, no pedal edema, no calf swelling. Auscultation: widespread expiratory wheeze with poor air entry at both bases. SpO2 84 percent on her home nasal cannula at 2 L/min. UNSTABLE: respiratory distress with accessory muscle use.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：清醒但极度疲惫，一次只能说一两个词，不肯躺下。考官（评估时给出）：气道通畅、可自行维持；呼吸 32 次/分、费力、辅助呼吸肌明显参与、呼气延长、可闻及喘鸣；桡动脉 118 次/分、规则。皮肤：苍白、口唇暗紫、温热潮湿。改良快速查体：桶状胸、无外伤、无足部水肿、无小腿肿胀。听诊：双肺广泛呼气相喘鸣，双肺底进气差。SpO2 在其家用鼻导管 2 L/min 下为 84%。不稳定：呼吸窘迫伴辅助呼吸肌参与。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: Alert (but note exhaustion - a falling LOC would signal impending failure)
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：Alert（但需注意疲惫——意识下降提示即将呼吸衰竭）

expected.actionEn: Verbalize c-spine not indicated
expected.actionZh: 口述无颈椎固定指征

expected.actionEn: Assess airway
expected.actionZh: 评估气道

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing thoroughly: rate, depth, effort, accessory muscle use, air entry and wheeze
expected.actionZh: 全面评估呼吸：频率、深度、做功、辅助肌参与、进气量与喘鸣

expected.actionEn: Auscultate the chest as part of the SOB assessment - the guideline lists auscultation explicitly
expected.actionZh: 按气促评估要求听诊胸部——指南明确列出听诊

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation
expected.actionZh: 评估循环

expected.actionEn: Modified rapid body survey appropriate to the presentation (barrel chest, edema, calf swelling)
expected.actionZh: 按表现做改良快速查体（桶状胸、水肿、小腿肿胀）

expected.actionEn: Note skin: pale with dusky lips, warm moist
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：苍白、口唇暗紫、温热潮湿

expected.actionEn: Apply HIGH-FLOW oxygen: a COPD patient complaining of SOB with SpO2 84 percent requires high-flow oxygen titrated to a target of 94 percent - do not withhold oxygen for fear of hypoxic drive
expected.actionZh: 给高流量氧：慢阻肺患者主诉气促且 SpO2 84% 时应给高流量并滴定至 94% 目标——不要因担心低氧驱动而不给氧

expected.actionEn: Keep her sitting upright and leaning forward; do not lay her flat and do not let her walk
expected.actionZh: 保持坐位前倾；不要让她平躺，也不要让她走动

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Respiratory distress with accessory muscle use = UNSTABLE, RTC. The guideline says transport immediately if able, delegating crew to prep egress otherwise, and to transport after the first salbutamol dose. Ready to load within 15 minutes; carry her, do not walk her.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。呼吸窘迫伴辅助呼吸肌参与=不稳定，RTC。指南要求：能立即转运就立即转运，否则指派搭档准备撤离路线，并在首剂沙丁胺醇后转运。15 分钟内可装载；须抬运，不得让她自己走。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC and act with urgency
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC 并保持紧迫感

expected.actionEn: Transport after the first salbutamol dose, ready to load within 15 minutes
expected.actionZh: 首剂沙丁胺醇后即转运，15 分钟内可装载

expected.actionEn: Delegate the partner to prep egress and bring the stretcher to the patient; manage the anxious daughter
expected.actionZh: 指派搭档准备撤离路线并把担架床推到患者身边；安抚焦虑的女儿

phases.infoEn: ACTOR AND DAUGHTER (patient answers in 1-2 words, daughter fills in): three days of worsening breathlessness with a productive cough and green sputum, fever yesterday. O - gradual over 3 days, much worse since 0600. P - sitting forward helps a little, lying down is impossible; her blue inhaler helped at first, not now. Q - tight, cannot get air out. R - no chest pain, no radiation. S - the worst she has been since her last admission. T - constant, progressive. She sleeps on two pillows normally, no worse than usual (against CHF), no leg swelling, no chest pain. PMHx: COPD with two admissions in the past year, 50 pack-year smoking history (quit 2 years ago), hypertension, no cardiac history. Meds: salbutamol MDI, tiotropium, home oxygen at 2 L/min, amlodipine. Allergies: none known. LOI: tea this morning, poor appetite for two days.
phases.infoZh: 患者与女儿（患者只能一两个词，由女儿补充）：气促加重 3 天，伴咳嗽咳绿痰，昨天发热。O——3 天内逐渐加重，06:00 后明显恶化。P——前倾坐着稍好，无法平躺；蓝色吸入器起初有效，现在无效。Q——胸闷、气呼不出去。R——无胸痛、无放射。S——是上次住院以来最重的一次。T——持续且进行性加重。她平时睡觉垫两个枕头，近来没有加重（不支持心衰），无下肢水肿，无胸痛。既往史：慢阻肺，过去一年住院两次，吸烟史 50 包年（2 年前戒烟），高血压，无心脏病史。用药：沙丁胺醇定量吸入剂、噻托溴铵、家用氧疗 2 L/min、氨氯地平。过敏：无已知。最后进食：今早喝了茶，两天来食欲差。

expected.actionEn: Establish chief complaint: worsening shortness of breath
expected.actionZh: 确立主诉：进行性加重的气促

expected.actionEn: HxC/C with OPQRRRST/LOTARP plus a respiratory-specific history: sputum, fever, orthopnea, puffer use and effect, comparison with previous exacerbations
expected.actionZh: 用 OPQRRRST/LOTARP 加呼吸专项病史：痰液、发热、端坐呼吸、吸入器使用与效果、与既往发作比较

expected.actionEn: PMHx incl COPD severity, admissions and smoking history
expected.actionZh: 既往史（含慢阻肺严重程度、住院史与吸烟史）

expected.actionEn: Medications incl how many puffs she has already taken this morning
expected.actionZh: 用药史（含今早已用了多少喷）

expected.actionEn: Allergies
expected.actionZh: 过敏史

expected.actionEn: LOI
expected.actionZh: 最后进食

phases.infoEn: Set 1 - baseline before medication: GCS 15 (E4V5M6); BP 158/88; pulse 118 regular; respirations 32 laboured; skin pale with dusky lips, warm moist; pupils equal reactive; SpO2 84 percent on 2 L nasal cannula, rising to 90 percent on high-flow; temperature 38.1 tympanic - indicated with infectious symptoms; BGL not indicated. Note for CPAP eligibility (PCP): RR above 24, SpO2 under 94 percent on oxygen, accessory muscle use, awake and following commands, systolic above 90 - she qualifies. RTC interval 5-6 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组——用药前基线：GCS 15（E4V5M6）；血压 158/88；脉搏 118 规则；呼吸 32 费力；皮肤苍白、口唇暗紫、温热潮湿；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 鼻导管 2 L 下 84%，改高流量后升至 90%；鼓膜体温 38.1——有感染症状时有指征；血糖无指征。CPAP 适应证核对（PCP）：呼吸频率>24、吸氧下 SpO2<94%、辅助肌参与、清醒并能听从指令、收缩压>90——她符合条件。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟。

expected.actionEn: GCS with components
expected.actionZh: GCS 及分项

expected.actionEn: BP by auscultation - required before CPAP (systolic must be above 90)
expected.actionZh: 听诊测血压——用 CPAP 前必测（收缩压须高于 90）

expected.actionEn: Pulse rate/strength/rhythm
expected.actionZh: 脉搏频率/强度/节律

expected.actionEn: Respirations rate/depth/character - the key vital in this call
expected.actionZh: 呼吸频率/深度/性质——本例最关键的生命体征

expected.actionEn: Skin hands-on
expected.actionZh: 动手查皮肤

expected.actionEn: Pupils
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔

expected.actionEn: SpO2 with calibration; record the change with each oxygen and drug intervention
expected.actionZh: SpO2 并校准；记录每次给氧与用药后的变化

expected.actionEn: Temperature - indicated with infectious respiratory symptoms
expected.actionZh: 体温——有呼吸道感染症状时有指征

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, en route, kept very brief because she is breathless. ACTOR/DAUGHTER: general - feverish and off her food for two days; CNS - no confusion at baseline, no headache; respiratory - productive green sputum, no hemoptysis, no chest pain, worse than her usual baseline; cardiovascular - no orthopnea beyond her usual two pillows, no ankle swelling, no palpitations; GI/GU - nil; integumentary - nil; musculoskeletal - nil; endocrine - no diabetes; EENT - sore throat and coryza last week.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP，途中完成且必须简短，因为患者气促明显。患者/女儿：整体——两天来发热、食欲差；中枢神经——平时无意识错乱、无头痛；呼吸——咳绿色脓痰、无咯血、无胸痛，比她平时基线明显加重；心血管——除平时两个枕头外无额外端坐呼吸、无踝部水肿、无心悸；消化/泌尿——无异常；皮肤——无异常；肌肉骨骼——无异常；内分泌——无糖尿病；眼耳鼻喉——上周有咽痛和流涕。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health (fever, appetite)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——整体健康（发热、食欲）

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS (baseline mentation)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——中枢神经（平时认知状态）

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory (pertinent: sputum, hemoptysis, baseline exercise tolerance)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——呼吸（重点：痰、咯血、平时活动耐量）

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular (differentiating COPD from CHF: orthopnea, edema)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——心血管（鉴别慢阻肺与心衰：端坐呼吸、水肿）

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——消化/泌尿

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——皮肤

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——肌肉骨骼

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——内分泌

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT (recent URTI)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——眼耳鼻喉（近期上呼吸道感染）

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE head-to-toe: head/neck - pursed-lip breathing, accessory neck muscle use, no JVD; chest - barrel-shaped, hyperresonant, widespread expiratory wheeze at all 6 sites with poor basal air entry, no crackles (against pulmonary edema); abdomen - soft, non-tender; back - posterior auscultation confirms the same findings, no sacral edema; lower extremities - no pedal edema, no calf tenderness (against DVT/PE); upper extremities - nicotine staining, no clubbing change, CSM intact.
phases.infoZh: 途中从头到脚：头颈——缩唇呼吸、颈部辅助肌参与、无颈静脉怒张；胸部——桶状胸、叩诊过清音、6 个听诊点广泛呼气相喘鸣且肺底进气差、无湿啰音（不支持肺水肿）；腹部——软、无压痛；背部——后侧听诊结果一致，无骶部水肿；下肢——无足部水肿、无小腿压痛（不支持深静脉血栓/肺栓塞）；上肢——烟渍着色、杵状指无变化、远端 CSM 完好。

expected.actionEn: Head/neck exam incl JVD and accessory muscle use
expected.actionZh: 头颈查体（含颈静脉怒张与辅助肌参与）

expected.actionEn: Chest exam with 6-site auscultation before and after bronchodilators, comparing bilaterally
expected.actionZh: 支气管扩张剂前后各做 6 点胸部听诊并双侧对比

expected.actionEn: Abdomen exam
expected.actionZh: 腹部查体

expected.actionEn: Back exam with posterior auscultation and sacral edema check
expected.actionZh: 背部查体（后侧听诊与骶部水肿检查）

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities - edema and calf tenderness to screen for CHF and DVT
expected.actionZh: 下肢——水肿与小腿压痛，用于筛查心衰与深静脉血栓

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities
expected.actionZh: 上肢

phases.infoEn: SOB with history of asthma/COPD protocol. ALL LEVELS: sit upright leaning forward, limit movement, primary survey, oxygen titrated to a target SpO2 of 94 percent (high flow is indicated in a COPD patient who is short of breath), AUSCULTATE, transport after the first dose, history and baseline vitals, SALBUTAMOL 5 mg by nebulizer (or 4 x 100 mcg by MDI with a spacer - MDI and spacer are strongly recommended with infectious respiratory symptoms), repeated as required. PCP ADDITIONS: ipratropium 500 mcg by nebulizer combined with salbutamol in the same nebulizer - ipratropium is a SINGLE dose while salbutamol may be repeated; dexamethasone 8 mg PO (preferred route); CPAP starting at 5 cmH2O with 5 L/min, increasing in 2.5 cmH2O steps to a maximum of 10 cmH2O; and for severe disease or imminent respiratory failure with SpO2 under 90 percent unresolved by salbutamol, epinephrine 0.5 mg IM. If she deteriorates and cannot maintain her own respiratory effort, REMOVE CPAP and ventilate with a BVM plus a PEEP valve starting at 5 cmH2O.
phases.infoZh: 哮喘/慢阻肺气促协议。各级别通用：坐位前倾、限制活动、完成初次评估、氧疗滴定至目标 SpO2 94%（慢阻肺患者主诉气促时有高流量指征）、听诊、首剂后即转运、采集病史与基线生命体征、沙丁胺醇雾化 5 mg（或定量吸入剂 4×100 mcg 配储雾罐——有呼吸道感染症状时强烈推荐吸入器加储雾罐），按需重复。PCP 追加：异丙托溴铵 500 mcg 与沙丁胺醇同一雾化杯联合雾化——异丙托溴铵只给一次，沙丁胺醇可重复；地塞米松 8 mg 口服（首选途径）；CPAP 起始 5 cmH2O 配 5 L/min，每次增加 2.5 cmH2O，最高 10 cmH2O；对重症或濒临呼吸衰竭、沙丁胺醇治疗后 SpO2 仍低于 90% 者，肌注肾上腺素 0.5 mg。若病情恶化、无法维持自主呼吸做功，须撤除 CPAP 并改用带 PEEP 阀（起始 5 cmH2O）的球囊面罩通气。

expected.actionEn: Initiate the SOB protocol with correct sequence: position, oxygen, auscultate, baseline vitals, then salbutamol, then transport
expected.actionZh: 按正确顺序启动气促协议：体位、给氧、听诊、基线生命体征，然后沙丁胺醇，然后转运

expected.actionEn: Salbutamol 5 mg by nebulizer (or MDI with spacer) with the 6 rights, repeated as required
expected.actionZh: 沙丁胺醇 5 mg 雾化（或吸入器加储雾罐），六项核对，按需重复

expected.actionEn: PCP: ipratropium 500 mcg as a SINGLE dose combined in the same nebulizer as salbutamol
expected.actionZh: PCP：异丙托溴铵 500 mcg 单次给药，与沙丁胺醇混于同一雾化杯

expected.actionEn: PCP: dexamethasone 8 mg PO
expected.actionZh: PCP：地塞米松 8 mg 口服

expected.actionEn: PCP: apply CPAP only after confirming ALL indications and NO contraindications; start at 5 cmH2O with 5 L/min and titrate in 2.5 cmH2O steps to a maximum of 10
expected.actionZh: PCP：确认全部适应证且无禁忌后再上 CPAP；起始 5 cmH2O 配 5 L/min，每次增 2.5 cmH2O，最高 10

expected.actionEn: Verbalize the deterioration plan: remove CPAP and ventilate with BVM plus PEEP if she can no longer maintain respiratory effort
expected.actionZh: 口述恶化预案：若她无法维持呼吸做功，撤 CPAP 改用球囊面罩加 PEEP 通气

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs, air entry and SpO2 after every intervention. Set 2 (after salbutamol/ipratropium and 10 minutes of CPAP, en route): GCS 15; BP 142/84; pulse 106 regular; respirations 24, less laboured, accessory muscle use reduced; skin pink, warm, moist; pupils equal reactive; SpO2 93 percent on CPAP at 7.5 cmH2O; temperature 38.1; auscultation shows improved air entry with reduced wheeze. Improving. EXAMINER ALTERNATIVE: if the candidate applies CPAP incorrectly or misses a contraindication, the patient's LOC falls and she can no longer follow commands - CPAP must then be removed and BVM ventilation with PEEP started.
phases.infoZh: 每次处置后复评 ABC、进气量与 SpO2。第 2 组（沙丁胺醇/异丙托溴铵后并 CPAP 治疗 10 分钟，途中）：GCS 15；血压 142/84；脉搏 106 规则；呼吸 24、费力程度减轻、辅助肌参与减少；皮肤红润、温暖、潮湿；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 在 7.5 cmH2O 的 CPAP 下为 93%；体温 38.1；听诊示进气改善、喘鸣减轻。病情好转。考官备选走向：若考生 CPAP 使用不当或漏掉禁忌，患者意识下降、无法听从指令——此时必须撤除 CPAP 并改用带 PEEP 的球囊面罩通气。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and all interventions after each drug, each CPAP change and each move
expected.actionZh: 每次给药、每次调整 CPAP 和每次移动后复评 ABC 与全部处置

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 5-6 minutes with a repeat auscultation to document the response
expected.actionZh: 5-6 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征并复听胸部以记录疗效

expected.actionEn: Titrate oxygen and CPAP to the SpO2 target and document each change
expected.actionZh: 按 SpO2 目标滴定氧疗与 CPAP 并记录每次调整

expected.actionEn: If LOC falls: remove CPAP and ventilate with a BVM plus PEEP valve at 5 cmH2O
expected.actionZh: 若意识下降：撤除 CPAP 并以球囊面罩加 5 cmH2O 的 PEEP 阀通气

phases.infoEn: Critical patient - notify the receiving facility en route. Hand-off must include drug doses and times, CPAP pressure and the response. PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 危重患者——途中通知接收医院。交接必须包含用药剂量与时间、CPAP 压力及治疗反应。5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: En-route notification for a critical respiratory patient
expected.actionZh: 危重呼吸患者途中预报

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off with drugs, CPAP settings, SpO2 trend and auscultation findings
expected.actionZh: 完整交接：用药、CPAP 参数、SpO2 变化趋势与听诊发现

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确 PCR

vitalsSets.skin: pale with dusky lips, warm moist
vitalsSets.spo2: 84% on 2 L NC, 90% on high flow

vitalsSets.timeHint: after salbutamol/ipratropium and 10 min CPAP, en route

criticalPitfallsEn: Withholding oxygen from a hypoxic COPD patient for fear of hypoxic drive - the guideline states high-flow oxygen IS indicated for COPD patients complaining of SOB; SpO2 84 percent must be treated
Walking the patient to the ambulance or laying her flat - exertion and positioning errors, up to 100%
Not auscultating the chest - the SOB guideline lists auscultation as a required step
PCP: applying CPAP without checking all indications and contraindications (LOC, systolic under 90, vomiting risk, pneumothorax, trauma) - protocol error up to 100%
PCP: repeating ipratropium - it is a single dose only; salbutamol is the drug that may be repeated
Leaving CPAP on a patient whose LOC is falling instead of switching to BVM with PEEP - major protocol error
criticalPitfallsZh: 因担心低氧驱动而对缺氧的慢阻肺患者不给氧——指南明确写明慢阻肺患者主诉气促时有高流量吸氧指征；SpO2 84% 必须处理
让患者自己走到救护车或让她平躺——用力与体位错误，最高扣 100%
不听诊胸部——气促指南将听诊列为必做步骤
PCP：未逐条核对适应证与禁忌就上 CPAP（意识水平、收缩压低于 90、呕吐风险、气胸、创伤性病因）——协议错误最高扣 100%
PCP：重复给异丙托溴铵——它只能给一次；可重复的是沙丁胺醇
患者意识下降却仍继续 CPAP 而不改用带 PEEP 的球囊面罩——重大协议错误
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR gives salbutamol 5 mg by nebulizer or 4 x 100 mcg by MDI with a spacer, repeated as required, plus positioning, high-flow oxygen titrated to 94 percent, auscultation and rapid transport. EMR does NOT have ipratropium, dexamethasone, CPAP or IM epinephrine for bronchospasm. If she deteriorates, EMR assists ventilations with a BVM. No Functional Enquiry.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR 给沙丁胺醇 5 mg 雾化或定量吸入剂 4×100 mcg 配储雾罐、按需重复，并配合体位、高流量吸氧滴定至 94%、听诊与快速转运。EMR 没有异丙托溴铵、地塞米松、CPAP，也不能为支气管痉挛肌注肾上腺素。若病情恶化，EMR 用球囊面罩辅助通气。无功能问诊。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds ipratropium 500 mcg as a single combined nebulizer dose, dexamethasone 8 mg PO, CPAP from 5 cmH2O titrated in 2.5 cmH2O steps to a maximum of 10 cmH2O with matched oxygen flow, a PEEP valve on the BVM if ventilation becomes necessary, and epinephrine 0.5 mg IM for severe bronchospasm with impending arrest. Functional Enquiry en route, kept brief.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 增加异丙托溴铵 500 mcg 单次混合雾化、地塞米松 8 mg 口服、CPAP 由 5 cmH2O 起每次加 2.5 cmH2O 至最高 10 cmH2O 并配相应氧流量、必要时球囊面罩加 PEEP 阀，以及重度支气管痉挛濒临骤停时肌注肾上腺素 0.5 mg。功能问诊在途中简要完成。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 71-year-old female with known COPD and two admissions in the past year, presenting with three days of worsening shortness of breath, productive green sputum and fever, now unable to speak more than one or two words at a time. On arrival she was tripoding with accessory muscle use, respirations 32 and laboured, widespread expiratory wheeze with poor basal air entry, SpO2 84 percent on her home 2 litres, BP 158/88, pulse 118, temperature 38.1. She is now respirations 24 with reduced accessory muscle use, SpO2 93 percent on CPAP at 7.5, BP 142/84, pulse 106, with improved air entry. History of COPD, 50 pack-year ex-smoker and hypertension; medications salbutamol, tiotropium, home oxygen and amlodipine; no known allergies. Treatments: kept upright and carried out, oxygen titrated toward 94 percent, salbutamol 5 milligrams with ipratropium 500 micrograms combined by nebulizer at 0824, dexamethasone 8 milligrams orally, and CPAP started at 5 and titrated to 7.5 centimetres of water. No crackles and no peripheral edema, so this looks like an infective exacerbation rather than pulmonary edema.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 71 岁女性，已知慢阻肺、过去一年住院两次，本次为气促加重 3 天，伴咳绿色脓痰和发热，现每次只能说一两个词。到场时呈三脚架体位、辅助呼吸肌明显参与、呼吸 32 次/分且费力、双肺广泛呼气相喘鸣伴肺底进气差、家用 2 升吸氧下 SpO2 84%、血压 158/88、脉搏 118、体温 38.1。目前呼吸 24 次/分、辅助肌参与减少、7.5 的 CPAP 下 SpO2 93%、血压 142/84、脉搏 106，进气明显改善。既往慢阻肺、50 包年已戒烟史、高血压；用药为沙丁胺醇、噻托溴铵、家庭氧疗和氨氯地平；无已知过敏。处置：保持坐位并由我们抬出，氧疗按 94% 目标滴定，08:24 沙丁胺醇 5 mg 与异丙托溴铵 500 mcg 混合雾化，地塞米松 8 mg 口服，CPAP 由 5 起始滴定至 7.5 cmH2O。双肺无湿啰音、无外周水肿，故考虑为感染性急性加重而非肺水肿。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Worsening shortness of breath over 3 days in known COPD, unable to speak full sentences
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Gradual onset over 3 days, much worse since 0600; productive green sputum, fever yesterday; own MDI ineffective this morning; worst since last admission; no orthopnea beyond baseline, no chest pain, no leg swelling
pcrKeyPoints.pmhx: COPD with 2 admissions in the past year, 50 pack-year ex-smoker, hypertension
pcrKeyPoints.meds: Salbutamol MDI, tiotropium, home O2 2 L/min, amlodipine
treatments: Upright leaning-forward position, carried to the ambulance
O2 titrated to target SpO2 94% (high flow indicated)
Salbutamol 5 mg neb, repeated as required
PCP: ipratropium 500 mcg single dose combined in the same neb
PCP: dexamethasone 8 mg PO
PCP: CPAP 5 cmH2O titrated to 7.5, BVM with PEEP on standby
findings: Tripod position, pursed-lip breathing, accessory muscle use
Widespread expiratory wheeze, poor basal air entry, no crackles
SpO2 84% on 2 L improving to 93% on CPAP; RR 32 to 24
Temperature 38.1 with purulent sputum - infective exacerbation
No JVD, no pedal edema - argues against CHF

scenarios.titleEn: Acute Stroke - FAST-VAN and the Last-Seen-Normal Clock
scenarios.titleZh: 急性卒中——FAST-VAN 与最后正常时间
scenarios.dispatchEn: 1105 hrs. Code 3 to a garden-suite home in Surrey. 68-year-old female with sudden right-sided weakness and slurred speech. Her husband called within minutes of onset. The nearest stroke-capable centre is 22 minutes away; the closest hospital without imaging is 8 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 11:05，Code 3 前往素里一处花园套间住宅。68 岁女性突发右侧肢体无力和言语含糊。其丈夫在发病数分钟内报警。最近的具备卒中救治能力的医院车程 22 分钟；最近的无影像能力医院车程 8 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: onset was witnessed at about 1050 while she was making tea. She is awake but cannot lift her right arm.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：发病时间约 11:50 前的 10:50，当时她正在泡茶，全程被目击。患者清醒但右臂抬不起来。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge; plan glucometer, oxygen, stroke assessment tool, and a stretcher to the patient
expected.actionZh: 确认；准备血糖仪、氧气、卒中评估工具，并把担架床推到患者身边

expected.actionEn: Recognize this is a time-critical call where the last-seen-normal time and destination choice determine the outcome
expected.actionZh: 认识到这是时间敏感的呼叫，最后正常时间和目的地选择决定预后

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: The husband meets you at the door and leads you to the kitchen. A dropped mug and spilled tea are on the floor - a slip hazard. The patient sits on a kitchen chair, propped by her husband, right side of the face drooping, drooling slightly. Nothing suggests a fall or head strike. One patient. Warm, well lit.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：丈夫在门口迎接并带你到厨房。地上有摔碎的杯子和洒出的茶水——存在滑倒风险。患者坐在餐椅上、由丈夫扶着，右侧面部下垂，口角轻微流涎。没有迹象提示跌倒或头部撞击。单一患者。房间温暖、照明良好。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (spilled liquid and broken mug), environment, nature of illness (possible stroke), one patient
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（洒出的液体与碎杯）、环境、发病性质（可能为卒中）、单一患者

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜

expected.actionEn: First look: right facial droop, drooling, right arm hanging limp, awake and frightened
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：右侧面部下垂、流涎、右臂无力下垂、清醒且惊恐

expected.actionEn: Confirm with the husband whether she fell or struck her head before deciding on spinal precautions
expected.actionZh: 在决定是否做脊柱防护前，先向丈夫确认她有没有跌倒或撞到头

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: awake, follows commands, understands everything but speech is slurred and effortful (dysarthria with some word-finding difficulty); frightened and tearful. EXAMINER (give when assessed): airway patent but she is drooling and has a weak swallow - aspiration risk; respirations 18, regular, adequate; radial pulse 88, IRREGULARLY IRREGULAR. Skin: pink, warm, dry. Modified RBS: no trauma anywhere, no incontinence, right arm and leg weak - she cannot hold the right arm up against gravity; right-sided facial droop; grip absent on the right, normal on the left. SpO2 96 percent RA. UNSTABLE by BC criteria: suspected CVA.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：清醒、能听从指令、完全听得懂，但言语含糊费力（构音障碍伴部分找词困难）；惊恐流泪。考官（评估时给出）：气道通畅但有流涎、吞咽无力——存在误吸风险；呼吸 18 次/分、规则、足够；桡动脉 88 次/分、绝对不齐。皮肤：红润、温暖、干燥。改良快速查体：全身无外伤、无失禁，右侧上下肢无力——右臂无法抗重力抬起；右侧面部下垂；右手握力消失，左手正常。SpO2 室内空气 96%。按 BC 标准属不稳定：疑似脑血管意外。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: Alert - and note that dysarthria is not a decreased LOC
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：Alert——并注意构音障碍并不等于意识下降

expected.actionEn: Verbalize c-spine not indicated after confirming no fall or head strike
expected.actionZh: 确认无跌倒、无头部撞击后口述无颈椎固定指征

expected.actionEn: Assess the airway and recognize the aspiration risk from drooling and a weak swallow - keep her NPO and have suction ready
expected.actionZh: 评估气道并识别流涎与吞咽无力带来的误吸风险——禁食禁水并备好吸引

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation and note the irregularly irregular pulse (atrial fibrillation - a stroke risk factor)
expected.actionZh: 评估循环并注意绝对不齐的脉搏（房颤——卒中危险因素）

expected.actionEn: Modified rapid body survey including a check for trauma and incontinence
expected.actionZh: 改良快速查体，包括检查外伤与失禁

expected.actionEn: Note skin: pink warm dry
expected.actionZh: 记录皮肤：红润温干

expected.actionEn: Provide supplemental oxygen only to maintain SpO2 at or above 94 percent - at 96 percent none is required; verbalize the decision
expected.actionZh: 仅按维持 SpO2≥94% 给氧——96% 时无需吸氧，需口述该决策

expected.actionEn: Position with the head of the bed elevated and the affected side supported; protect the airway given the drooling
expected.actionZh: 抬高床头并支撑患侧肢体；因流涎需保护气道

phases.infoEn: Decision point. Suspected CVA = UNSTABLE, RTC. Timely transport with early notification of the receiving facility is a specified intervention in the Stroke guideline. Ready to load within 15 minutes. Destination: bypass the closer non-imaging hospital for the stroke-capable centre and state that reasoning aloud.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。疑似脑血管意外=不稳定，RTC。卒中指南明确要求及时转运并尽早通知接收医院。15 分钟内可装载。目的地：跳过较近但无影像能力的医院、直送具备卒中救治能力的中心，并需口述这一理由。

expected.actionEn: Categorize as RTC and act with urgency
expected.actionZh: 判定为 RTC 并保持紧迫感

expected.actionEn: Ready to load within 15 minutes - on-scene time is brain tissue
expected.actionZh: 15 分钟内可装载——现场每一分钟都是脑组织

expected.actionEn: Choose the stroke-capable centre and verbalize the bypass rationale; notify the facility while en route
expected.actionZh: 选择具备卒中救治能力的中心并口述绕行理由；途中通知该院

phases.infoEn: HUSBAND ANSWERS (patient can answer yes/no and short words): she was completely normal at 1050, talking while making tea; the mug fell from her right hand and her face changed within seconds - LAST SEEN NORMAL 1050, WITNESSED ONSET. No headache, no vomiting, no seizure, no fall, no head strike. Symptoms have not improved. She had a similar episode lasting 10 minutes two weeks ago that resolved, and she did not seek care. PMHx: atrial fibrillation, hypertension, type 2 diabetes, previous TIA. Meds: apixaban 5 mg twice daily (LAST DOSE 0800 TODAY - critical for the stroke team), metoprolol, metformin, perindopril. Allergies: none known. LOI: tea and toast at 0900; nothing since the onset.
phases.infoZh: 丈夫回答（患者只能回答是/否和简短词语）：10:50 时她完全正常，边泡茶边说话；杯子从右手滑落，几秒内面部就变了样——最后正常时间 10:50，发病过程被目击。无头痛、无呕吐、无抽搐、无跌倒、无头部撞击。症状至今没有好转。两周前曾有一次类似发作持续 10 分钟后自行缓解，当时未就医。既往史：房颤、高血压、2 型糖尿病、既往短暂性脑缺血发作。用药：阿哌沙班 5 mg 每日两次（今日最后一次服药时间 08:00——对卒中团队至关重要）、美托洛尔、二甲双胍、培哚普利。过敏：无已知。最后进食：09:00 茶和吐司；发病后未再进食。

expected.actionEn: Establish chief complaint: sudden right-sided weakness and slurred speech
expected.actionZh: 确立主诉：突发右侧肢体无力与言语含糊

expected.actionEn: HxC/C centred on the LAST SEEN NORMAL time and whether onset was witnessed, plus progression, headache, vomiting, seizure and previous TIA
expected.actionZh: 现病史以最后正常时间和发病是否被目击为核心，并问进展、头痛、呕吐、抽搐及既往短暂性脑缺血发作

expected.actionEn: PMHx incl atrial fibrillation, diabetes, hypertension and previous TIA
expected.actionZh: 既往史（含房颤、糖尿病、高血压、既往短暂性脑缺血发作）

expected.actionEn: Medications - especially anticoagulants and the exact time of the last dose
expected.actionZh: 用药史——尤其是抗凝药及最后一次服药的具体时间

expected.actionEn: Allergies
expected.actionZh: 过敏史

expected.actionEn: LOI - relevant to both anesthesia planning and aspiration risk
expected.actionZh: 最后进食——与麻醉计划和误吸风险都相关

phases.infoEn: Set 1: GCS 14 (E4 V4 M6 - confused/dysarthric speech scores V4 here as speech is not fully oriented and intelligible); BP 186/104; pulse 88 irregularly irregular; respirations 18; skin pink warm dry; pupils equal and reactive, 3 mm; SpO2 96 percent RA; BGL 8.9 - MANDATORY, the Stroke guideline lists a blood glucose check as a required intervention because hypoglycemia mimics stroke; temperature 36.8. FAST-VAN: Face - right droop positive; Arm - right drift positive; Speech - slurred positive; Time - 1050; Vision - no field loss; Aphasia - mild word-finding difficulty; Neglect - none. RTC interval 5-6 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组：GCS 14（E4 V4 M6——构音障碍伴找词困难，言语不能完全清晰定向，故 V 计 4 分）；血压 186/104；脉搏 88 绝对不齐；呼吸 18；皮肤红润温干；瞳孔等大有反应，3 mm；SpO2 室内空气 96%；血糖 8.9——必测，卒中指南将血糖检查列为必做项，因为低血糖可完全模拟卒中；体温 36.8。FAST-VAN：Face 右侧下垂阳性；Arm 右臂坠落阳性；Speech 言语含糊阳性；Time 10:50；Vision 无视野缺损；Aphasia 轻度找词困难；Neglect 无忽视。RTC 间隔 5-6 分钟。

expected.actionEn: GCS with components
expected.actionZh: GCS 及分项

expected.actionEn: BP by auscultation - document the hypertension; do NOT attempt to lower it
expected.actionZh: 听诊测血压——记录高血压；不得试图降压

expected.actionEn: Pulse - identify the irregularly irregular rhythm
expected.actionZh: 脉搏——识别绝对不齐的节律

expected.actionEn: Respirations rate/depth/character
expected.actionZh: 呼吸频率/深度/性质

expected.actionEn: Skin hands-on
expected.actionZh: 动手查皮肤

expected.actionEn: Pupils - required in a neurological presentation and repeated every set
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔——神经系统表现必查且每组复查

expected.actionEn: SpO2 with calibration
expected.actionZh: SpO2 并校准

expected.actionEn: BGL - explicitly required by the Stroke guideline to exclude hypoglycemia as a stroke mimic
expected.actionZh: 血糖——卒中指南明确要求，用于排除低血糖这一卒中模拟症

expected.actionEn: Perform and document a formal FAST-VAN assessment for accurate recognition
expected.actionZh: 完成并记录规范的 FAST-VAN 评估以实现准确识别

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY, en route, adapted to her speech difficulty using yes/no questions and the husband. ACTOR: general - well until today; CNS - right-sided weakness and numbness, no headache, no visual loss, no seizure, one previous TIA two weeks ago; respiratory - nil; cardiovascular - known atrial fibrillation, takes a blood thinner; GI/GU - no incontinence, swallowing feels difficult; integumentary - nil; musculoskeletal - right arm and leg weak; endocrine - type 2 diabetes, sugars usually well controlled; EENT - no double vision, no facial numbness on the left.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP，途中完成，因言语困难需改用是非题并借助丈夫。患者演员：整体——今天之前一切正常；中枢神经——右侧无力和麻木、无头痛、无视力丧失、无抽搐、两周前有过一次短暂性脑缺血发作；呼吸——无异常；心血管——已知房颤、在服抗凝药；消化/泌尿——无失禁、感觉吞咽困难；皮肤——无异常；肌肉骨骼——右侧上下肢无力；内分泌——2 型糖尿病、血糖通常控制良好；眼耳鼻喉——无复视、左侧面部无麻木。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——整体健康

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS (the core system here: weakness, numbness, vision, headache, previous TIA)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——中枢神经（本例核心：无力、麻木、视觉、头痛、既往短暂性脑缺血发作）

expected.actionEn: FE - Respiratory
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——呼吸

expected.actionEn: FE - Cardiovascular (atrial fibrillation and anticoagulation)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——心血管（房颤与抗凝）

expected.actionEn: FE - GI/GU (swallowing, incontinence)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——消化/泌尿（吞咽、失禁）

expected.actionEn: FE - Integumentary
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——皮肤

expected.actionEn: FE - Musculoskeletal
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——肌肉骨骼

expected.actionEn: FE - Endocrine (diabetes)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——内分泌（糖尿病）

expected.actionEn: FE - EENT (diplopia, facial sensation)
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——眼耳鼻喉（复视、面部感觉）

phases.infoEn: EN ROUTE head-to-toe: head/neck - right facial droop involving the lower face with forehead sparing, tongue deviates right, no trauma, no neck stiffness; chest - clear and equal at all 6 sites, irregular heart rhythm; abdomen - soft, non-tender; back - no findings; lower extremities - right leg weak at 2 out of 5 versus 5 out of 5 on the left, sensation reduced on the right; upper extremities - right arm 1 out of 5 with no grip, left 5 out of 5, right arm drifts and falls immediately when raised.
phases.infoZh: 途中从头到脚：头颈——右侧面部下垂累及下半面部而额纹保留、伸舌偏右、无外伤、颈部无强直；胸部——6 点听诊清晰对称、心律不齐；腹部——软、无压痛；背部——无异常；下肢——右腿肌力 2/5、左腿 5/5，右侧感觉减退；上肢——右臂肌力 1/5 且无握力、左臂 5/5，右臂抬起后立即坠落。

expected.actionEn: Head/neck exam incl facial symmetry, tongue deviation and trauma screen
expected.actionZh: 头颈查体（含面部对称性、伸舌偏斜与外伤筛查）

expected.actionEn: Chest exam with 6-site auscultation
expected.actionZh: 胸部查体并 6 点听诊

expected.actionEn: Abdomen exam
expected.actionZh: 腹部查体

expected.actionEn: Back exam
expected.actionZh: 背部查体

expected.actionEn: Lower extremities with bilateral strength and sensory comparison documented
expected.actionZh: 下肢并记录双侧肌力与感觉对比

expected.actionEn: Upper extremities with bilateral grip strength and arm drift documented
expected.actionZh: 上肢并记录双侧握力与上肢坠落试验

phases.infoEn: Stroke guideline, all levels: assess and manage ABCs; supplemental oxygen to maintain SpO2 at or above 94 percent; position the patient appropriately with the head elevated and the affected limbs supported; BLOOD GLUCOSE CHECK; accurate recognition using FAST-VAN; timely transport with notification of the receiving facility while en route. Keep her NPO - nothing by mouth given the swallow risk. Do not delay for a full head-to-toe on scene. PCP ADDITION (en route): obtain vascular access using an 18 gauge above the level of the wrist, PREFERABLY ON THE RIGHT SIDE, because the left arm may be needed for imaging and intervention access.
phases.infoZh: 卒中指南（各级别通用）：评估并处理 ABC；给氧维持 SpO2≥94%；采取合适体位，抬高头部并支撑患侧肢体；测血糖；用 FAST-VAN 做准确识别；及时转运并在途中通知接收医院。保持禁食禁水——因吞咽风险不得经口给任何东西。不要为在现场完成从头到脚查体而延误。PCP 追加（途中）：用 18 G 针在腕部以上建立静脉通路，优先选右侧，因为左臂可能需要留给影像检查和介入通路使用。

expected.actionEn: Execute the Stroke protocol: ABCs, oxygen to target, positioning, BGL, FAST-VAN, timely transport with notification
expected.actionZh: 执行卒中协议：ABC、按目标给氧、体位、血糖、FAST-VAN、及时转运并预报

expected.actionEn: Establish and document the last-seen-normal time precisely - it determines thrombolysis and thrombectomy eligibility
expected.actionZh: 精确确定并记录最后正常时间——它决定溶栓与取栓资格

expected.actionEn: Keep the patient NPO and have suction available given the drooling and weak swallow
expected.actionZh: 因流涎和吞咽无力，保持禁食禁水并备好吸引

expected.actionEn: PCP: vascular access en route with an 18 G above the wrist, preferably on the right
expected.actionZh: PCP：途中在腕部以上用 18 G 建立静脉通路，优先右侧

expected.actionEn: Do not give ASA, oral glucose, or anything by mouth in a suspected stroke with a swallowing deficit
expected.actionZh: 疑似卒中伴吞咽障碍者不得给阿司匹林、口服葡萄糖或任何经口物品

phases.infoEn: Reassess ABCs, GCS and the neurological deficit after every move and at least every 5 minutes - stroke deficits change. Set 2 (en route): GCS 14 (E4V4M6); BP 178/98; pulse 92 irregularly irregular; respirations 18; skin pink warm dry; pupils equal reactive; SpO2 96 percent RA; BGL 8.9; FAST-VAN unchanged, right arm still 1 out of 5. EXAMINER OPTION: if the candidate has not been reassessing, escalate - her speech becomes unintelligible and she begins to vomit, requiring immediate suction and repositioning.
phases.infoZh: 每次移动后及至少每 5 分钟复评 ABC、GCS 与神经功能缺损——卒中的表现会变化。第 2 组（途中）：GCS 14（E4V4M6）；血压 178/98；脉搏 92 绝对不齐；呼吸 18；皮肤红润温干；瞳孔等大有反应；SpO2 室内空气 96%；血糖 8.9；FAST-VAN 无变化，右臂仍为 1/5。考官备选：若考生一直不复评，则升级病情——她言语变得无法辨识并开始呕吐，需要立即吸引和调整体位。

expected.actionEn: Reassess ABCs and interventions after each move and each change in presentation
expected.actionZh: 每次移动及每次表现变化后复评 ABC 与各项处置

expected.actionEn: Second full set of vitals within 5-6 minutes plus a repeat neurological assessment
expected.actionZh: 5-6 分钟内完成第二组完整生命体征并复评神经功能

expected.actionEn: Manage any vomiting immediately with suction and positioning without compromising the airway
expected.actionZh: 一旦呕吐立即吸引并调整体位，不得危及气道

expected.actionEn: Continue to protect the affected limbs and reassure a frightened patient who can hear and understand everything
expected.actionZh: 持续保护患侧肢体，并安抚这位听得懂一切的惊恐患者

phases.infoEn: Critical patient - early stroke-team notification is essential and is named in the guideline. The hand-off MUST lead with the last-seen-normal time and the anticoagulant. PCR within 5 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 危重患者——尽早通知卒中团队至关重要，指南中已明确列出。交接时必须首先报告最后正常时间和抗凝药情况。5 分钟内完成 PCR。

expected.actionEn: Early en-route stroke-team notification stating the last-seen-normal time
expected.actionZh: 尽早途中通知卒中团队并说明最后正常时间

expected.actionEn: Complete hand-off leading with last-seen-normal, FAST-VAN findings, BGL and anticoagulant use with the time of the last dose
expected.actionZh: 完整交接，开头即报最后正常时间、FAST-VAN 发现、血糖及抗凝药与末次服药时间

expected.actionEn: Accurate PCR within 5 minutes
expected.actionZh: 5 分钟内完成准确 PCR

criticalPitfallsEn: Not obtaining a blood glucose - hypoglycemia is the classic stroke mimic and the guideline lists a glucose check as a required intervention
Failing to establish and report the last-seen-normal time - the single most important piece of information for the stroke team
Transporting to the closest hospital instead of a stroke-capable centre without justification - destination error captured in transport and call management
Giving ASA, oral glucose or anything by mouth to a patient with a swallowing deficit - non-indicated intervention with aspiration risk
Delaying scene time to complete a full head-to-toe when it should be done en route - transport timing deduction
Treating dysarthria as a decreased LOC and immobilizing or over-treating instead of recognizing a focal deficit
criticalPitfallsZh: 不测血糖——低血糖是典型的卒中模拟症，指南已将血糖检查列为必做处置
未确定并报告最后正常时间——这是对卒中团队最重要的单项信息
无正当理由送最近医院而非具备卒中救治能力的中心——目的地错误，计入转运与呼叫管理扣分
给有吞咽障碍的患者阿司匹林、口服葡萄糖或任何经口物品——非指征操作且有误吸风险
为在现场做完整从头到脚查体而延长现场时间（本应在途中完成）——转运时限扣分
把构音障碍误当作意识下降，从而做固定或过度处置，而不是识别为局灶性神经缺损
scenarios.emrVariantEn: EMR performs the entire Stroke guideline: ABCs, oxygen titrated to 94 percent or above, positioning, blood glucose check, FAST-VAN recognition, NPO, timely transport and notification. EMR does not establish vascular access. No Functional Enquiry. EMR must not give ASA for a stroke - ASA in the BC guidelines is for cardiac chest pain, not CVA.
scenarios.emrVariantZh: EMR 可完成整套卒中指南：ABC、氧疗滴定至 94% 以上、体位、测血糖、FAST-VAN 识别、禁食禁水、及时转运与预报。EMR 不建立静脉通路。无功能问诊。EMR 不得因卒中给阿司匹林——BC 考纲中阿司匹林的适应证是心源性胸痛，不是脑血管意外。
scenarios.pcpVariantEn: PCP adds en-route vascular access with an 18 gauge above the wrist, preferably on the right side so the left is free for imaging and intervention, plus the 9-system Functional Enquiry adapted to her speech deficit. No fluid bolus is indicated with a normal blood pressure, and the hypertension must not be treated pre-hospitally.
scenarios.pcpVariantZh: PCP 增加途中用 18 G 在腕部以上建立静脉通路（优先右侧，把左侧留给影像与介入），并结合其言语障碍调整方式完成 9 系统功能问诊。血压正常时无补液指征，且院前不得处理这种高血压。
scenarios.handoffModelEn: This is a 68-year-old female with a witnessed stroke onset - LAST SEEN NORMAL at 1050 while making tea, so we are about 35 minutes from onset. Chief complaint is sudden right-sided weakness and slurred speech. FAST-VAN is positive for face, arm and speech: right lower facial droop, right arm 1 out of 5 with no grip, right leg 2 out of 5, dysarthria with mild word-finding difficulty, no visual field loss and no neglect. Initial vitals GCS 14, BP 186/104, pulse 88 irregularly irregular, resps 18, SpO2 96 percent on room air, blood glucose 8.9, temperature 36.8; latest BP 178/98, pulse 92, deficit unchanged. Critically, she is on apixaban 5 milligrams twice daily and her last dose was 0800 today. She also has atrial fibrillation, hypertension, type 2 diabetes and a TIA two weeks ago that she did not report. Treatments: airway monitored with suction available, kept nil by mouth because of a weak swallow, head elevated with the right side supported, oxygen not required at 96 percent, IV 18 gauge in the right forearm, and we bypassed the local hospital directly to you with pre-notification.
scenarios.handoffModelZh: 患者 68 岁女性，卒中发病过程被目击——最后正常时间为 10:50 泡茶时，距发病约 35 分钟。主诉为突发右侧肢体无力和言语含糊。FAST-VAN 面部、上肢、言语三项阳性：右侧下半面部下垂，右臂肌力 1/5 且无握力，右腿 2/5，构音障碍伴轻度找词困难，无视野缺损、无忽视。首组生命体征 GCS 14、血压 186/104、脉搏 88 绝对不齐、呼吸 18、SpO2 室内空气 96%、血糖 8.9、体温 36.8；末组血压 178/98、脉搏 92，神经缺损无变化。关键信息：她在服阿哌沙班 5 mg 每日两次，今日最后一次服药时间为 08:00。既往还有房颤、高血压、2 型糖尿病，以及两周前一次未就医的短暂性脑缺血发作。处置：全程监测气道并备好吸引，因吞咽无力予以禁食禁水，抬高头部并支撑右侧肢体，血氧 96% 故未吸氧，右前臂 18 G 静脉通路，并绕过本地医院直送贵院、已提前预报。

pcrKeyPoints.cc: Sudden right-sided weakness and slurred speech (suspected acute CVA)
pcrKeyPoints.hxcc: Witnessed onset, last seen normal 1050 while making tea; mug dropped from right hand, face changed within seconds; no headache, vomiting, seizure or fall; similar 10-minute episode two weeks ago that resolved
pcrKeyPoints.pmhx: Atrial fibrillation, hypertension, type 2 diabetes, previous TIA
pcrKeyPoints.meds: Apixaban 5 mg BID (last dose 0800 today), metoprolol, metformin, perindopril
treatments: ABCs assessed, suction available, kept NPO for weak swallow
O2 not required (SpO2 96%) - target 94% or above stated
Head elevated, affected limbs supported
BGL obtained (8.9) to exclude hypoglycemic mimic
FAST-VAN performed and documented; last-seen-normal established
Stroke-centre bypass with en-route notification
PCP: IV 18 G right forearm above the wrist
findings: FAST-VAN positive: right facial droop, right arm 1/5 no grip, right leg 2/5, dysarthria with word-finding difficulty
Irregularly irregular pulse consistent with atrial fibrillation
BP 186/104 - not treated pre-hospitally
Deficit unchanged between both assessments
Anticoagulated on apixaban, last dose 0800

scenarios.titleEn: Mild Hypothermia - Elderly Woman in an Unheated Home
scenarios.titleZh: 轻度低体温——独居老人无暖气住宅
scenarios.dispatchEn: 0900 hrs. Code 3 to a detached house in Chilliwack. 82-year-old female, wellness check requested by a neighbour who has not seen her for two days. The furnace has been broken since a power outage. Outside temperature is minus 4 degrees C. Hospital is 15 minutes away.
scenarios.dispatchZh: 09:00，Code 3 前往奇利瓦克一处独立屋。82 岁女性，邻居已两天未见到她，请求上门查看。停电后暖炉一直坏着。室外气温零下 4 摄氏度。医院车程 15 分钟。

phases.infoEn: Dispatch adds: police attended, gained entry and report the patient is awake, cold to touch and 'a bit muddled'. Fire is not attending.
phases.infoZh: 调度补充：警察已到场破门进入，报告患者清醒、身体冰凉、「有点糊涂」。消防不到场。

expected.actionEn: Acknowledge; plan thermometer, warm blankets, hot packs, glucometer, and preheat the ambulance to 30 degrees C
expected.actionZh: 确认；准备体温计、加温毯、热敷包、血糖仪，并把救护车预热到 30 摄氏度

expected.actionEn: Anticipate that the ambulance interior must be warmed BEFORE the patient is loaded
expected.actionZh: 预判必须在装载患者之前先把车厢加温

phases.infoEn: EXAMINER SCRIPT: The house is dim and very cold - a thermometer on the wall reads 8 degrees C. Police have opened the front door, letting in more cold air. The patient sits in a recliner wrapped in a thin blanket, wearing a housecoat that is damp at the back from incontinence. Newspapers dating back two days are on the mat. A space heater is unplugged. One patient. No CO source running.
phases.infoZh: 考官脚本：屋内昏暗且非常冷——墙上温度计显示 8 摄氏度。警察已把前门打开，冷空气持续灌入。患者裹着一条薄毯坐在躺椅上，穿的家居袍背部因失禁而潮湿。门垫上堆着两天的报纸。取暖器插头没插。单一患者。现场没有在运行的一氧化碳来源。

expected.actionEn: Verbalize hazards (cold environment, open door worsening heat loss, possible CO from heating attempts - none found), environment, nature of illness (environmental exposure), one patient
expected.actionZh: 口述危险源（寒冷环境、敞开的门加剧散热、取暖可能产生的一氧化碳——本例未发现）、环境、发病性质（环境暴露）、单一患者

expected.actionEn: ACT on the environmental hazard: close the door and stop ongoing heat loss before beginning the assessment
expected.actionZh: 对环境危险采取行动：先关门、阻止持续散热，再开始评估

expected.actionEn: Don gloves and eye protection
expected.actionZh: 戴手套和护目镜

expected.actionEn: First look: elderly female, shivering, pale, slow to respond, damp clothing, cold room
expected.actionZh: 第一眼：老年女性、寒战、面色苍白、反应迟缓、衣物潮湿、房间寒冷

phases.infoEn: ACTOR: awake, opens her eyes spontaneously, answers slowly and is disoriented to the day and date but knows her name and that she is at home; SHIVERING VIGOROUSLY. EXAMINER (give when assessed): airway clear and self-maintained; respirations 16, regular; radial pulse 56, regular and weak - take up to 30-45 seconds to assess a pulse in a cold patient. Skin: pale, COLD to touch centrally including the trunk and abdomen, dry apart from the damp clothing. Modified RBS: no trauma, no injury from a fall - she says she did not fall; mild dependent edema in both ankles, no focal weakness. SpO2 reads 89 percent but the probe is on a cold finger and the trace is poor - a peripherally shut-down reading; on a warmed ear probe it is 95 percent. STABLE: alert, shivering, mild hypothermia.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员：清醒、能自主睁眼，回答缓慢，对星期和日期定向障碍，但知道自己的名字和身处家中；正在剧烈寒战。考官（评估时给出）：气道通畅、可自行维持；呼吸 16 次/分、规则；桡动脉 56 次/分、规则而细弱——低体温患者触脉最多可用 30-45 秒。皮肤：苍白，包括躯干和腹部在内的中心部位触之冰凉，除衣物潮湿外皮肤干燥。改良快速查体：无外伤、无跌倒所致损伤——她自述没有摔倒；双踝轻度体位性水肿，无局灶性无力。SpO2 显示 89%，但探头夹在冰凉手指上且波形差——属外周血管收缩造成的读数；换用加温耳探头后为 95%。稳定：清醒、有寒战、轻度低体温。

expected.actionEn: Assess LOC / AVPU: Alert but disoriented - note that confusion is itself a hypothermia sign
expected.actionZh: 评估意识 / AVPU：Alert 但有定向障碍——注意意识模糊本身就是低体温的表现

expected.actionEn: Verbalize c-spine not indicated after confirming there was no fall
expected.actionZh: 确认无跌倒后口述无颈椎固定指征

expected.actionEn: Assess airway
expected.actionZh: 评估气道

expected.actionEn: Assess breathing
expected.actionZh: 评估呼吸

expected.actionEn: Assess circulation, taking 30-45 seconds to confirm a pulse in a cold patient before concluding pulselessness
expected.actionZh: 评估循环，低体温患者在判定无脉前须用 30-45 秒确认脉搏

expected.actionEn: Modified rapid body survey looking for occult injury, especially a fall she may not recall
expected.actionZh: 改良快速查体，寻找隐匿损伤，尤其是她可能不记得的跌倒

expected.actionEn: Assess skin temperature CENTRALLY (trunk/abdomen), not just at the hands
expected.actionZh: 在躯干/腹部等中心部位而不仅仅是手部评估皮肤温度

expected.actionEn: REMOVE the damp clothing and cover with dry blankets - stopping heat loss is the first intervention
expected.actionZh: 脱去潮湿衣物并盖上干燥毯子——阻止散热是首要处置

expected.actionEn: Verbalize the oxygen decision and recognize the unreliable peripheral SpO2 reading in a cold patient
expected.actionZh: 口述给氧决策，并识别低体温患者外周 SpO2 读数不可靠

expected.actionEn: Position of comfort, handle gently, and avoid rough handling
expected.actionZh: 舒适体位、轻柔搬动、避免粗暴操作

phases.infoEn: Decision point. She is alert, shivering, maintaining her own airway with a temperature of 33.4 degrees C - this is MILD hypothermia (above 32 and below 35), not severe. STABLE, NON-RTC: assess, actively rewarm, package and be ready to load within 30 minutes. NOTE the contrast: severe hypothermia below 28 degrees C would be an unstable, rapid-transport patient in whom you do NOT actively rewarm.
phases.infoZh: 决策点。患者清醒、有寒战、能自行维持气道，体温 33.4 摄氏度——属轻度低体温（高于 32 且低于 35），并非重度。稳定，非 RTC：完成评估、主动复温、打包，30 分钟内可装载。请注意对比：体温低于 28 摄氏度的重度低体温属不稳定、需快速转运，且不得主动复温。

expected.actionEn: Categorize correctly as non-RTC and justify it with the temperature band and her mental status
expected.actionZh: 正确判定为非 RTC，并以体温分级和意识状态作为依据

expected.actionEn: Ready to load within 30 minutes, with active rewarming started on scene
expected.actionZh: 30 分钟内可装载，并已在现场开始主动复温

expected.actionEn: Verbalize the temperature thresholds and how the plan would change with severe hypothermia
expected.actionZh: 口述体温分级阈值，以及若为重度低体温处置将如何改变

phases.infoEn: ACTOR ANSWERS SLOWLY (police and the neighbour help): the furnace stopped working during a power outage two days ago; she did not want to bother anyone. She has been in the recliner most of that time, has not eaten much and has been drinking tea. She denies falling, denies chest pain and denies shortness of breath. She has been incontinent of urine because she was too cold and stiff to get up. O - gradual over two days. P - blankets helped at first. Q - 'cold all the way through', shivering, stiff. R - no pain radiation, general aching. S - feels weaker than yesterday. T - continuous. PMHx: hypothyroidism, osteoarthritis, hypertension, mild dementia diagnosed last year. Meds: levothyroxine, acetaminophen prn, amlodipine. Allergies: none known. LOI: half a piece of toast and tea yesterday afternoon.
phases.infoZh: 患者演员回答缓慢（警察和邻居协助补充）：两天前停电后暖炉就坏了；她不想麻烦别人。这两天大部分时间都窝在躺椅上，吃得很少，一直在喝茶。她否认摔倒、否认胸痛、否认气促。因为太冷太僵硬起不来，已发生小便失禁。O——两天内逐渐加重。P——毯子起初有用。Q——「从里到外都冷」，寒战、身体发僵。R——疼痛不放射，全身酸痛。S——感觉比昨天更虚弱。T——持续存在。既往史：甲状腺功能减退、骨关节炎、高血压、去年诊断的轻度痴呆。用药：左甲状腺素、对乙酰氨基酚按需、氨氯地平。过敏：无已知。最后进食：昨天下午半片吐司和茶。

expected.actionEn: Establish chief complaint: feeling cold, weak and confused after two days without heating
expected.actionZh: 确立主诉：无暖气两天后出现寒冷、虚弱与意识模糊

expected.actionEn: HxC/C with OPQRRRST/LOTARP plus exposure history: duration, ambient temperature, wet clothing, food and fluid intake, alcohol, any fall
expected.actionZh: 用 OPQRRRST/LOTARP 采集现病史并补充暴露史：持续时间、环境温度、衣物是否潮湿、进食饮水、饮酒、有无跌倒

expected.actionEn: PMHx - hypothyroidism is a key predisposing cause of hypothermia
expected.actionZh: 既往史——甲状腺功能减退是低体温的重要易感因素

expected.actionEn: Medications
expected.actionZh: 用药史

expected.actionEn: Allergies
expected.actionZh: 过敏史

expected.actionEn: LOI - poor intake contributes to hypoglycemia and reduced heat production
expected.actionZh: 最后进食——摄入不足会导致低血糖并减少产热

phases.infoEn: Set 1: GCS 14 (E4 V4 M6 - disoriented to time); BP 104/62; pulse 56 regular and weak; respirations 16 regular; skin pale and cold centrally, dry; pupils equal and reactive but sluggish; SpO2 95 percent on a warmed ear probe (peripheral reading unreliable); BGL 3.6 mmol/L - LOW, and mandatory with an altered LOC; TEMPERATURE 33.4 degrees C tympanic - THE DEFINING VITAL SIGN in this call. Non-RTC interval: repeat within about 15 minutes.
phases.infoZh: 第 1 组：GCS 14（E4 V4 M6——时间定向障碍）；血压 104/62；脉搏 56 规则而细弱；呼吸 16 规则；皮肤苍白、中心部位冰凉、干燥；瞳孔等大有反应但迟钝；SpO2 用加温耳探头为 95%（外周读数不可靠）；血糖 3.6 mmol/L——偏低，且意识改变时必测；鼓膜体温 33.4 摄氏度——本例最关键的生命体征。非 RTC 间隔：约 15 分钟内复测。

expected.actionEn: GCS with components
expected.actionZh: GCS 及分项

expected.actionEn: BP by auscultation
expected.actionZh: 听诊测血压

expected.actionEn: Pulse - allow 30-45 seconds in a cold patient and report rate, strength and rhythm
expected.actionZh: 脉搏——低体温患者给足 30-45 秒，并报告频率、强度与节律

expected.actionEn: Respirations rate/depth/character
expected.actionZh: 呼吸频率/深度/性质

expected.actionEn: Skin assessed centrally, hands-on
expected.actionZh: 在中心部位动手评估皮肤

expected.actionEn: Pupils
expected.actionZh: 瞳孔

expected.actionEn: SpO2 - recognize and comment on an unreliable peripheral reading in a cold patient
expected.actionZh: SpO2——识别并说明低体温患者外周读数不可靠

expected.actionEn: BGL - mandatory with decreased LOC; 3.6 mmol/L is below 4.0 and must be corrected
expected.actionZh: 血糖——意识下降时必测；3.6 mmol/L 低于 4.0，必须纠正

expected.actionEn: TEMPERATURE - explicitly required in environmental patients and it drives the entire treatment plan
expected.actionZh: 体温——环境急症患者明确要求测量，并决定整个治疗方案

phases.infoEn: PCP ONLY. ACTOR: general - weak, poor appetite, has not been herself for two days; CNS - confused about the date, no headache, no weakness on one side, no fall; respiratory - no cough or SOB; cardiovascular - no chest pain, no palpitations; GI/GU - urinary incontinence from immobility and cold, no diarrhea, poor fluid intake; integumentary - cold and mottled skin, no frostbite on the fingers or toes; musculoskeletal - stiff and aching all over, arthritis worse in the cold; endocrine - hypothyroidism, she thinks she has missed some levothyroxine doses; EENT - no ear pain, hearing aid not in.
phases.infoZh: 仅 PCP。患者演员：整体——虚弱、食欲差、两天来状态不对；中枢神经——分不清日期、无头痛、无单侧无力、无跌倒；呼吸——无咳嗽气促；心血管——无胸痛心悸；消化/泌尿——因活动受限和寒冷导致小便失禁、无腹泻、饮水少；皮肤——冰凉、有花斑，手指足趾无冻伤；肌肉骨骼——全身僵硬酸痛，天冷时关节炎加重；内分泌——甲状腺功能减退，她觉得自己漏服过几次左甲状腺素；眼耳鼻喉——无耳痛，助听器没戴。

expected.actionEn: FE - General health
expected.actionZh: 功能问诊——整体健康

expected.actionEn: FE - CNS (confusion, fall screen)
